jobs.description:
Die Bachem-Gruppe investiert in einen neuen geplanten Standort im Sisslerfeld in der Nordwestschweiz. Dieser Schritt ist Teil der langfristigen Strategie, die Produktionskapazitäten bis zum Ende des Jahrzehnts auszubauen. Der neue Produktionsstandort wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Planungsphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die Organisation der Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, sind wir stets auf der Suche nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Technical Operations suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als MES Design Engineer - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

Deine Aufgaben:

• Implementierung, Konfiguration und Validierung des MES Systems PAS-X für die neue Produktionslinie

• Entwicklung und Design elektronischer Master Batch Records (eMBR) unter Berücksichtigung von GMP-Standards und Prozessanforderungen

• Integration des MES mit dem Prozessleitsystem (PCS 7 / PCS neo) zur Automatisierung von Datenflüssen und Reduktion manueller Eingaben

• Umsetzung eines effizienten Review-by-Exception-Konzepts zur Qualitätsoptimierung und Reduktion von Review-Aufwand

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Produktion, Automation, Qualität und IT sowie globalen Einheiten zur Definition und Umsetzung der Systemanforderungen

• Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität, GMP-Compliance und Rückverfolgbarkeit der Herstellprozesse

• Mitwirkung bei Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsaktivitäten (URS, FS, IQ, OQ)

• Schulung und Support der Endanwender im Umgang mit dem MES

• Laufende Weiterentwicklung des Systems und Unterstützung bei Change Control Prozessen

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Chemie, Life Science, Ingenieurwesen, Pharma-Technologie, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PAS-X in einer GMP-regulierten Umgebung (Niveau Power User)

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Modellierung von eMBRs und MES-Workflows

• Erfahrung in der Integration von MES mit PLS-Systemen, insbesondere Siemens PCS 7 (und idealerweise PCS neo)

• Gute Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Anforderungen (GMP, GAMP 5, Datenintegrität, Annex 11 / CFR Part 11)

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Affinität zu digitalen Lösungen

• Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit in einem interdisziplinären Umfeld

• Optional: Erfahrung in der Administration von Windows und Windows Server Systemen, Datenbanken, und Netzwerk-Kenntnisse

• Kenntnisse im Bereich IT System / Software Qualifizierung (GMP, GAMP, CSV)

• Grundkenntnisse im Bereich Automatisierung (OPC UA) von Vorteil

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie strukturierte, dokumentationsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in una nuova sede pianificata a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase di progettazione del progetto offre opportunità uniche per plasmare attivamente l'organizzazione del futuro.

Al fine di guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo sempre alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team di operazioni tecniche, stiamo cercando una personalità dedicata come MES Design Engineer - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

I vostri compiti:

• Attuazione, configurazione e validazione del sistema MES PAS-X per la nuova linea di produzione

• Sviluppo e progettazione di record elettronici master batch (eMBR) tenendo conto degli standard GMP e dei requisiti di processo

• Integrazione del MES con il sistema di controllo del processo (PCS 7 / PCS neo) per automatizzare i flussi di dati e ridurre gli input manuali

• Attuazione di un efficiente concetto di revisione per eccellenza per l'ottimizzazione della qualità e la riduzione dello sforzo di revisione

• Una stretta collaborazione con la produzione, l'automazione, la qualità e l'IT e le unità globali per la definizione e l'implementazione dei requisiti di sistema

• Garantire l'integrità dei dati, la conformità GMP e la tracciabilità dei processi produttivi

• Partecipazione alle attività di qualificazione e validazione (URS, FS, IQ, OQ)

• Formazione e sostegno degli utenti finali nell'affrontare il MES

• Miglioramento del sistema e sostegno ai processi di controllo dei cambiamenti

Il tuo profilo:

• Studi completi in chimica, scienze della vita, ingegneria, tecnologia farmaceutica, informatica o una qualifica paragonabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza con PAS-X in un ambiente regolato da GMP (livello utente di potenza)

• Conoscenza approfondita nella modellazione eMBR e flussi di lavoro MES

• Esperienza nell'integrazione di MES con sistemi PLS, in particolare Siemens PCS 7 (e idealmente PCS neo)

• Buona conoscenza dei requisiti normativi (GMP, GAMP 5, Integrità dei dati, allegato 11 / CFR Parte 11)

• pensiero analitico, metodi di lavoro strutturati e affinità per soluzioni digitali

• Forza di comunicazione e lavoro di squadra in un ambiente interdisciplinare

• Opzionale: Esperienza nell'amministrazione di sistemi Windows e Windows Server, database e competenze di rete

• Conoscenza del sistema IT / qualificazione software (GMP, GAMP, CSV)

• Conoscenza di base dell'automazione (OPC UA) è un vantaggio

• Forte capacità di team e comunicazione, nonché metodi di lavoro strutturati e orientati alla documentazione

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con lo sviluppo interno e ulteriori opportunità di istruzione

• Ore di lavoro flessibili con la possibilità di ufficio domestico e la possibilità di acquistare vacanze aggiuntive con carico di lavoro ridotto

• Azienda-internal KITA sul Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• Il 60% dei contributi del fondo pensionistico di Bachem e la possibilità di un'offerta sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio elettorale

• Accesso a piattaforme vantaggiose con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Varie attività sportive gratuite sul Campus Bachem

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora che i tuoi documenti applicativi siano completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella nostra posizione a Stein!
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned location in Sisslerfeld in northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The planning phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to actively shape the organization of the future.

In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are always looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our technical operations team, we are looking for a dedicated personality as a MES Design Engineer - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

Your tasks:

• Implementation, configuration and validation of the MES system PAS-X for the new production line

• Development and design of electronic master batch records (eMBR) taking into account GMP standards and process requirements

• Integration of the MES with the process control system (PCS 7 / PCS neo) to automate data flows and reduce manual inputs

• Implementation of an efficient review-by-exception concept for quality optimization and reduction of review effort

• Close cooperation with production, automation, quality and IT as well as global units for the definition and implementation of system requirements

• Ensuring data integrity, GMP compliance and traceability of manufacturing processes

• Participation in qualification and validation activities (URS, FS, IQ, OQ)

• Training and support of end users in dealing with the MES

• Ongoing further development of the system and support for change control processes

Your profile:

• Completed studies in chemistry, life science, engineering, pharmaceutical technology, computer science or a comparable qualification

• Several years of experience with PAS-X in a GMP-regulated environment (power user level)

• In-depth knowledge in modeling eMBRs and MES workflows

• Experience in integrating MES with PLS systems, especially Siemens PCS 7 (and ideally PCS neo)

• Good knowledge of regulatory requirements (GMP, GAMP 5, Data Integrity, Annex 11 / CFR Part 11)

• Analytical thinking, structured working methods and affinity for digital solutions

• Communication strength and teamwork in an interdisciplinary environment

• Optional: Experience in administration of Windows and Windows Server systems, databases, and network skills

• Knowledge of IT system / software qualification (GMP, GAMP, CSV)

• Basic knowledge of automation (OPC UA) is an advantage

• Strong team and communication skills as well as structured, documentation-oriented working methods

• Good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Flexible working hours with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

• Company-internal KITA on the Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60% takeover of the pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our election savings plan

• Access to advantage platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our inspiring working environment at our location in Stein!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouvel emplacement prévu à Sisslerfeld dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de planification du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner activement l'organisation du futur.

Afin de stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons toujours des spécialistes hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe d'opérations techniques, nous recherchons une personnalité dédiée en tant qu'ingénieur de conception MES - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

Vos tâches :

• Mise en œuvre, configuration et validation du système MES PAS-X pour la nouvelle ligne de production

• Mise au point et conception de registres électroniques des lots maîtres (eMBR) en tenant compte des normes et des exigences des BPF

• Intégration du MES au système de contrôle des processus (PCS 7 / PCS neo) pour automatiser les flux de données et réduire les entrées manuelles

• Mise en œuvre d'un concept efficace d'examen par exception pour l'optimisation de la qualité et la réduction des efforts d'examen

• Coopération étroite avec la production, l'automatisation, la qualité et l'informatique ainsi qu'avec les unités mondiales pour la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences du système

• Assurer l'intégrité des données, la conformité aux BPF et la traçabilité des procédés de fabrication

• Participation aux activités de qualification et de validation (URS, FS, IQ, OQ)

• Formation et soutien des utilisateurs finals dans le traitement du MES

• Poursuite du développement du système et appui aux processus de contrôle du changement

Votre profil:

• Études terminées en chimie, sciences de la vie, génie, technologie pharmaceutique, informatique ou une qualification comparable

• Plusieurs années d'expérience avec PAS-X dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF (niveau utilisateur de puissance)

• Connaissance approfondie de la modélisation des flux de travail eMBR et MES

• Expérience dans l'intégration de MES avec les systèmes PLS, en particulier Siemens PCS 7 (et idéalement PCS neo)

• Bonne connaissance des exigences réglementaires (BPF, GAMP 5, Intégrité des données, annexe 11 / CFR partie 11)

• Pensée analytique, méthodes de travail structurées et affinité pour les solutions numériques

• La force de la communication et le travail d'équipe dans un environnement interdisciplinaire

• Optionnel: Expérience dans l'administration des systèmes Windows et Windows Server, des bases de données et des compétences réseau

• Connaissance du système de TI / qualification de logiciel (GMP, GAMP, CSV)

• La connaissance de base de l'automatisation (OPC UA) est un avantage

• Des compétences solides en équipe et en communication ainsi que des méthodes de travail structurées et axées sur la documentation

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

Notre offre :

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec développement interne et possibilités de formation continue

• Heures de travail flexibles avec possibilité de bureau à domicile et possibilité d'acheter des vacances supplémentaires avec une charge de travail réduite

• Société-interne KITA sur le campus Bachem Bubendorf

• Prise en charge de 60% des cotisations des caisses de retraite par Bachem ainsi que possibilité d'une provision trop obligatoire avec notre plan d'épargne électorale

• Accès à des plateformes avantageuses avec des réductions de partenaires externes

• Des aliments frais, sains et divers dans notre restaurant du personnel

• Diverses activités sportives gratuites sur le campus de Bachem

Voulez-vous stimuler l'innovation avec nous ?

Avons-nous suscité votre intérêt ? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience vos documents de candidature complets via notre portail d'applications.

En savoir plus sur le groupe Bachem et être inspiré par notre environnement de travail inspirant à notre emplacement à Stein!

This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacities by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The planning phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to actively shape the organization of the future.

In order to drive our continuous growth, we are always looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our Manufacturing and Process Technology (MPT) team within Technical Operations (TechOps), we are looking for a dedicated personality as an Expert Process Specialist Manufacturing & Process Technology - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% .

Their tasks:

• Support of Head MPT Sisslerfeld in building a local MPT team in Stein within the global MPT organization

• Participation in the development of MPT business processes in the course of location development

• High motivation and initiative for working on a project for the establishment of a new location

• Structured, precise and quality-conscious working methods with high standards of documentation, compliance and continuous improvement

• Independent and solution-oriented working methods and the ability to develop pragmatic solutions in complex or unclear situations

Our offer:

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

As Downstream Process Expert - API Production Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% , you will play a key technical role in establishing and later developing downstream manufacturing operations for API production. During the project phase, you will support the planning, design, commissioning, and start-up of manufacturing facilities and processes, ensuring GMP-compliant implementation. Once operations are established, you will take technical ownership of downstream processes and drive their continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Your tasks

• Provide technical leadership for the establishment, commissioning, and further development of downstream processing operations for API manufacturing

• Support the planning and design of manufacturing equipment, facilities, and production areas, including the development of technical specifications and process concepts

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve GMP-compliant downstream manufacturing processes

• Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and risk assessments

• Provide technical support during commissioning, start-up, and the operation and optimization of manufacturing equipment and processes

• Troubleshoot process- and equipment-related issues and drive sustainable improvement measures

• Collaborate closely with TechOps, Engineering, QA, Operations, and Project Management

• Support regulatory inspections and customer audits and contribute to operational excellence initiatives

Your profile

• PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline

• Several years of experience in API downstream processing within a GMP-regulated environment; knowledge of SPPS is an advantage

• Experience in the planning, construction, commissioning, start-up, or expansion of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

• In-depth knowledge of preparative chromatography, lyophilization and spray drying

• Strong knowledge of chemical process engineering, equipment and facility design, and relevant regulatory requirements, including ICH Q7, FDA, and EMA

• Experience with process control systems and recipe configuration

• Strong technical affinity combined with a structured, solution-oriented approach to complex engineering challenges

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with fluency in German and English, both written and spoken

Our offer:

• The role offers broad exposure across global Technical Operations and Innovation Platforms and close collaboration with senior stakeholders, enabling strong professional visibility and the opportunity to shape groupwide innovation long-term.

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to shape global Operational Readiness frameworks with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

• Sostenere la progettazione e la progettazione di attrezzature, impianti e aree di produzione, tra cui lo sviluppo di specifiche tecniche e concetti di processo

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'elaborazione API a valle all'interno di un ambiente regolato da GMP; La conoscenza di SPPS è un vantaggio

• Esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione, messa in servizio, start-up o espansione di impianti di produzione farmaceutica

• Forte conoscenza dell'ingegneria dei processi chimici, dell'attrezzatura e della progettazione delle strutture e dei requisiti normativi rilevanti, tra cui ICH Q7, FDA e EMA

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

As Downstream Process Expert - API Production Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% , you will play a key technical role in establishing and later developing downstream manufacturing operations for API production. During the project phase, you will support the planning, design, commissioning, and start-up of manufacturing facilities and processes, ensuring GMP-compliant implementation. Once operations are established, you will take technical ownership of downstream processes and drive their continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Your tasks

• Provide technical leadership for the establishment, commissioning, and further development of downstream processing operations for API manufacturing

• Support the planning and design of manufacturing equipment, facilities, and production areas, including the development of technical specifications and process concepts

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve GMP-compliant downstream manufacturing processes

• Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and risk assessments

• Provide technical support during commissioning, start-up, and the operation and optimization of manufacturing equipment and processes

• Troubleshoot process- and equipment-related issues and drive sustainable improvement measures

• Collaborate closely with TechOps, Engineering, QA, Operations, and Project Management

• Support regulatory inspections and customer audits and contribute to operational excellence initiatives

Your profile

• PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline

• Several years of experience in API downstream processing within a GMP-regulated environment; Knowledge of SPPS is an advantage

• Experience in the planning, construction, commissioning, start-up, or expansion of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities

• In-depth knowledge of preparation chromatography, lyophilization and spray drying

• Strong knowledge of chemical process engineering, equipment and facility design, and relevant regulatory requirements, including ICH Q7, FDA, and EMA

• Experience with process control systems and recipe configuration

• Strong technical affinity combined with a structured, solution-oriented approach to complex engineering challenges

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with fluency in German and English, both written and spoken

Our offer:

• The role offers broad exposure across global Technical Operations and Innovation Platforms and close collaboration with senior stakeholders, enabling strong professional visibility and the opportunity to shape groupwide innovation long-term.

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to shape global Operational Readiness Frameworks with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and our working environment at the Bubendorf site on our website.

Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation.

En tant qu'expert en processus aval - API Production Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% , vous jouerez un rôle technique clé dans l'établissement et le développement ultérieur d'opérations de fabrication en aval pour la production d'API. Au cours de la phase du projet, vous soutiendrez la planification, la conception, la mise en service et le démarrage d'installations et de procédés de fabrication, en assurant la mise en oeuvre conforme aux BPF. Une fois les opérations établies, vous prendrez la propriété technique des processus en aval et dirigerez leur amélioration continue et leur excellence opérationnelle.

Vos tâches

• Fournir un leadership technique pour l'établissement, la mise en service et le développement des opérations de transformation en aval pour la fabrication d'API

• Appuyer la planification et la conception des équipements de fabrication, des installations et des secteurs de production, y compris l'élaboration de spécifications techniques et de concepts de procédés

• Élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et améliorer continuellement les procédés de fabrication en aval conformes aux BPF

• Préparer, examiner et tenir à jour la documentation technique, les PNE et les évaluations des risques

• Fournir un soutien technique pendant la mise en service, le démarrage, le fonctionnement et l'optimisation des équipements et des procédés de fabrication

• Dépannage des problèmes liés aux processus et à l'équipement et lancement de mesures d'amélioration durable

• Collaborer étroitement avec TechOps, Ingénierie, AQ, Opérations et Gestion de Projet

• Appuyer les inspections réglementaires et les vérifications des clients et contribuer aux initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle

Votre profil

• Doctorat en chimie, chimie pharmaceutique ou discipline scientifique connexe

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le traitement en aval des IPA dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF; La connaissance des SPPS est un avantage

• Expérience dans la planification, la construction, la mise en service, le démarrage ou l'expansion d'installations de fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques

• Connaissance approfondie de la chromatographie de préparation, de la lyophilisation et du séchage par pulvérisation

• Connaissance approfondie de l'ingénierie des procédés chimiques, de la conception de l'équipement et des installations et exigences réglementaires pertinentes, y compris l'ICH Q7, la FDA et l'EMA

• Expérience des systèmes de contrôle des processus et de la configuration des recettes

• Forte affinité technique associée à une approche structurée et axée sur la solution des défis complexes de l'ingénierie

• Excellente capacité de communication, de gestion des parties prenantes et de gestion de projet, avec maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais, écrit et parlé

Notre offre :

• Ce rôle offre une large visibilité à l'échelle mondiale dans le domaine des opérations techniques et des plateformes d'innovation et une collaboration étroite avec les principaux intervenants, permettant une forte visibilité professionnelle et l'occasion de façonner l'innovation à long terme à l'échelle du groupe.

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne

• Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes

• 60 % de la couverture des cotisations de la caisse de retraite par Bachem AG, ainsi que l'option pour les prestations de retraite extra-obligatoires avec notre Régime de retraite Plus

• Accès à la plateforme d'avantages Swibeco avec des rabais de partenaires externes

• Des aliments frais, sains et variés dans notre restaurant du personnel

This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacities by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The planning phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to actively shape the organization of the future.

As part of the planned site development, the System Expert Materials Management Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% ensures that material management processes are mapped efficiently, GMP-compliant and sustainable in the planned systems. The role significantly contributes to the development and successful commissioning of digital solutions for storage, production supply, sampling, dispensing, tank farm management and disposal processes.

• Active participation in the development of the new location and in the design of the future materials management organization

• Representation of the requirements of the operator organisation in the design, implementation and further development of the system landscape

• Development and optimization of end-to-end processes taking into account organizational, operational and systemic interfaces

• Examination and professional approval of project-relevant documents as well as ensuring compliance with safety, environmental and quality requirements

• Support building a powerful, efficient and digitally supported materials management organization

• Higher education in logistics, supply chain management, business informatics, industrial engineering or a comparable discipline

• Several years of experience in the conception, introduction or further development of business processes and digital solutions

• Strong understanding of end-to-end processes and their organizational and systemic mapping

• Very good knowledge of integrated system landscapes, especially in the environment of ERP, WMS and MES; Experience with SAP or SAP-related logistics processes and SAP EWM is advantageous

• Experience in the project environment as well as in cooperation with interdisciplinary teams and different stakeholders

• Experience in a regulated production environment, ideally in the pharmaceutical, chemical or similar industry, is beneficial

• Analytical and structured personality with strong end-to-end thinking and the ability to transform complex relationships into workable solutions

• High level of initiative, a sense of responsibility and strong communication as well as the pleasure of helping to shape new structures and solutions in a dynamic project environment

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Flexible working hours with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum zu unterstützen, suchen wir laufend nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Massenspektrometrie-Service-Teams suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Lab Technician in unserem analytischen Labor.

Wir suchen:

Als engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit bist Du Teil unserer agilen QC-Serviceeinheit. Dich erwarten vielfältige Aufgaben in einem dynamischen und spannenden Umfeld. In dieser wichtigen Position führst Du GMP-konforme Analysen von Startmaterialien, Zwischenprodukten sowie Peptid- und Oligonukleotidwirkstoffen durch. Ein zusätzlicher Schwerpunkt liegt auf der unabhängigen Überprüfung analytischer Auswertungen und Ergebnisse im Rahmen von Doppelchecks .

Deine Verantwortung:

• Analytik zur Freigabe von Startmaterialien, Zwischen- und Endprodukten mittels Massenspektrometrie

• Gewissenhafte GMP-konforme Dokumentation und Auswertung der durchgeführten Analysen

• Durchführung unabhängiger Doppelchecks von analytischen Rohdaten, Auswertungen, Berechnungen und Ergebnissen auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und GMP-Konformität

• Klare Dokumentation festgestellter Unstimmigkeiten sowie Abstimmung notwendiger Korrekturen mit den zuständigen Mitarbeitenden

• Mitwirkung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung analytischer Fragestellungen und Arbeitsabläufe im Routineumfeld

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Chemielaborant/in, Fachrichtung Analytik oder Synthese, oder vergleichbare Weiterbildungen

• Berufserfahrung in einem industriellen Labor

• Kenntnisse in gängigen, im GMP-Umfeld üblichen IT-Applikationen (z. B. LIMS) sowie allgemeine Softwareaffinität

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bist ein Teamplayer und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team.

• Zuverlässige Persönlichkeit, die zu einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld beiträgt

• Begeisterung für Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative

jobs.description:
Bist Du kurz vor Lehrstellensuche und interessiert an einem Schuppertag als Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie?
 Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Berufsbeschreibung
 Der Beruf Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie wird in zwei Fachbereiche eingeteilt:

Synthese

Aus zwei oder mehreren Ausgangsstoffen stellst Du, bei uns in der Bachem AG, eine Vielfalt an neuen Peptiden, Aminosäurederivaten und anderen organischen Substanzen und Verbindungen her. Laboranten berechnen die Mengen der einzusetzenden Ausgangsstoffe und lassen sie miteinander reagieren. Aus dem Reaktionsgemisch isolieren sie das gewünschte Produkt und reinigen anschliessend das erhaltene Rohprodukt. Die so hergestellten Substanzen werden von ihnen auf Menge, Qualität und Zusammensetzung analysiert. Im Lehrgang mit Schwerpunkt Synthese wird ein besonderer Wert auf die Herstellung von Substanzen gelegt.

Laboranten arbeiten im Team unter Verwendung einer Vielfalt von Glasapparaturen und computerunterstützten Geräten. Alle Arbeitsschritte und Reaktionsabläufe werden genau beobachtet und protokolliert, damit die Arbeiten zur fortlaufenden Prozessverbesserung beitragen.

Analytik

Laboranten mit Schwerpunkt Analytik sind hauptsächlich in der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) tätig. Dabei begleiten sie den gesamten Warenfluss durch die Firma. In der Eingangskontrolle werden die Rohmaterialien auf ihre Identität, ihre Reinheit und andere Kriterien überprüft. Im Verlauf einer Synthese werden für die produzierenden Bereiche ergänzende Analysen mit verschiedensten Methoden durchgeführt. Ist ein Produkt fertig gestellt, wird es von der QC einer detaillierten Endanalyse (Schlusskontrolle) unterzogen, bei der alle zum Voraus definierten Qualitätsanforderungen überprüft werden. Bei diesen Analysen wird eine Vielzahl an Resultaten generiert, welche die Laboranten anschliessend auswerten, verarbeiten, umrechnen und vergleichen. Der Umgang mit kleinen Probenmengen, das Arbeiten mit zum Teil hochkomplexen, computergesteuerten Geräten , sowie das Auswerten von Resultaten mit hochspezifischer Software gehören zum Alltag.

Dein Profil

• Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Prozessen

• Logisches und vernetztes Denken

• Eine gute Beobachtungsgabe sowie ein exaktes und sauberes Arbeiten

• Teamfähig, zuverlässige, flexible Persönlichkeit

• Ausdauer und körperliche Belastbarkeit

Ablauf

Wir zeigen dir an diesem Tag wie spannend und abwechslungsreich dieser Beruf ist. Du wirst von den Auszubildenden auf ihre Linienplätze mitgenommen und kannst so direkt all deine Fragen stellen. Der Tag startet mit dem Einblick in die Synthese und nach einem gemeinsamen Mittagessen geht es in der Analytik weiter.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei poco prima di cercare un apprendistato e interessato a uno Schuppertag come assistente di laboratorio / nel campo della chimica?
Allora hai proprio ragione con noi!

Descrizione professionale
La professione di tecnico/chimica di laboratorio è divisa in due discipline:

Sintesi

Da due o più materiali di partenza, si producono una varietà di nuovi peptidi, derivati di amminoacidi e altre sostanze e composti organici. I laboratori calcolano gli importi dei materiali di partenza da utilizzare e permettono loro di reagire tra loro. Essi isolano il prodotto desiderato dalla miscela di reazione e successivamente purificano il prodotto grezzo ottenuto. Le sostanze così preparate sono analizzate da loro per quantità, qualità e composizione. Nel corso con particolare attenzione alla sintesi, si pone particolare enfasi sulla produzione di sostanze.

I tecnici di laboratorio lavorano in un team utilizzando una varietà di apparecchi di vetro e dispositivi assistiti da computer. Tutte le fasi di lavoro e le sequenze di reazione sono strettamente monitorate e registrate in modo che il lavoro contribuisca al miglioramento continuo del processo.

Analisi

I tecnici di laboratorio con un focus sull'analisi sono principalmente coinvolti nel controllo della qualità (QC). Essi accompagnano l'intero flusso di merci attraverso l'azienda. Il controllo delle entrate controlla le materie prime per la loro identità, purezza e altri criteri. Nel corso di una sintesi, vengono effettuate analisi complementari utilizzando una vasta gamma di metodi per le aree di produzione. Una volta completato un prodotto, viene sottoposto a un'analisi finale dettagliata (ispezione finale) dal QC, in cui vengono verificati tutti i requisiti di qualità definiti in anticipo. In queste analisi vengono generati un gran numero di risultati, che gli operatori di laboratorio valutano, elaborano, convertono e confrontano. La gestione di piccole quantità di campione, lavorando con dispositivi a volte altamente complessi, controllati dal computer e la valutazione dei risultati con software altamente specifico fanno parte della vita quotidiana.

Il tuo profilo

• Interessi nei processi scientifici

• pensiero logico e in rete

• Buone capacità di osservazione e lavoro preciso e pulito

• Personalità capace, affidabile, flessibile

• Resistenza e resistenza fisica

Data di scadenza

Vi mostriamo in questo giorno quanto sia eccitante e variata questa professione. Sarete portati dai tirocinanti ai loro posti di linea e può fare tutte le vostre domande direttamente. La giornata inizia con l'intuizione della sintesi e dopo un pranzo congiunto continua nell'analisi.

Per un'applicazione con noi, ti chiediamo di caricare scansioni / fotocopie dei seguenti documenti:

• Certificato attuale

• CV tabulare

• Lettera di motivazione

• Copia del passaporto
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you shortly before looking for an apprenticeship and interested in a Schuppertag as a laboratory assistant / in the field of chemistry?
Then you are exactly right with us!

Professional description
The profession of laboratory technician/chemistry is divided into two disciplines:

Synthesis

From two or more starting materials, you produce a variety of new peptides, amino acid derivatives and other organic substances and compounds. Laborators calculate the amounts of starting materials to be used and allow them to react with each other. They isolate the desired product from the reaction mixture and subsequently purify the crude product obtained. The substances thus prepared are analyzed by them for quantity, quality and composition. In the course with a focus on synthesis, special emphasis is placed on the production of substances.

Laboratory technicians work in a team using a variety of glass apparatus and computer-assisted devices. All work steps and reaction sequences are closely monitored and recorded so that the work contributes to continuous process improvement.

Analysis

Laboratory technicians with a focus on analytics are mainly involved in quality control (QC). They accompany the entire flow of goods through the company. The entry control checks the raw materials for their identity, purity and other criteria. In the course of a synthesis, supplementary analyses are carried out using a wide variety of methods for the production areas. Once a product has been completed, it is subjected to a detailed final analysis (final inspection) by the QC, in which all quality requirements defined in advance are checked. In these analyses, a large number of results are generated, which the laboratory operators subsequently evaluate, process, convert and compare. Handling small sample quantities, working with sometimes highly complex, computer-controlled devices and evaluating results with highly specific software are part of everyday life.

Your profile

• Interest in Scientific Processes

• Logical and networked thinking

• Good observation skills as well as precise and clean work

• Team capable, reliable, flexible personality

• Endurance and physical resilience

Expiry date

We show you on this day how exciting and varied this profession is. You will be taken by the trainees to their line places and can ask all your questions directly. The day starts with the insight into the synthesis and after a joint lunch it continues in the analysis.

For an application with us, we ask you to upload scans / photocopies of the following documents:

• Current certificate

• Tabular CV

• Letter of motivation

• Copy of passport

Êtes-vous peu avant de chercher un apprentissage et intéressé par un Schuppertag comme assistant de laboratoire / dans le domaine de la chimie?
Alors tu as exactement raison avec nous !

Description professionnelle
La profession de technicien de laboratoire/chimie est divisée en deux disciplines:

Synthèse

À partir de deux matériaux de départ ou plus, vous produisez une variété de nouveaux peptides, dérivés des acides aminés et d'autres substances et composés organiques. Les laborateurs calculent les quantités de matériaux de départ à utiliser et leur permettent de réagir entre eux. Ils isolent le produit désiré du mélange de réaction et purifient ensuite le produit brut obtenu. Les substances ainsi préparées sont analysées par elles pour la quantité, la qualité et la composition. Dans le cours axé sur la synthèse, une attention particulière est accordée à la production de substances.

Les techniciens de laboratoire travaillent en équipe à l'aide d'appareils en verre et d'appareils assistés par ordinateur. Toutes les étapes de travail et les séquences de réaction sont surveillées et enregistrées de près afin que le travail contribue à l'amélioration continue du processus.

Analyse

Les techniciens de laboratoire axés sur l'analyse participent principalement au contrôle de la qualité (QC). Ils accompagnent tout le flux de marchandises à travers l'entreprise. Le contrôle d'entrée vérifie l'identité, la pureté et d'autres critères des matières premières. Au cours d'une synthèse, des analyses complémentaires sont effectuées à l'aide d'une grande variété de méthodes pour les zones de production. Une fois qu'un produit a été achevé, il est soumis à une analyse finale détaillée (inspection finale) par le CQ, au cours de laquelle toutes les exigences de qualité définies à l'avance sont vérifiées. Dans ces analyses, un grand nombre de résultats sont produits, que les exploitants de laboratoire évaluent, traitent, convertissent et comparent par la suite. La manipulation de petites quantités d'échantillons, le travail avec des appareils parfois très complexes, contrôlés par ordinateur et l'évaluation des résultats avec des logiciels hautement spécifiques font partie de la vie quotidienne.

Votre profil

• Intérêt pour les processus scientifiques

• Pensée logique et en réseau

• Bonnes techniques d'observation ainsi qu'un travail précis et propre

• Personnalité compétente, fiable, flexible

• Endurance et résilience physique

Date d'expiration

Nous vous montrons aujourd'hui à quel point cette profession est passionnante et variée. Vous serez amenés par les stagiaires à leur place et pourrez poser vos questions directement. La journée commence par un aperçu de la synthèse et après un déjeuner commun, elle se poursuit dans l'analyse.

Pour une application avec nous, nous vous demandons de télécharger des scans / photocopies des documents suivants:

• Certificat actuel

• CV tabulaire

• Lettre de motivation

• Copie du passeport

Stell dir vor, du arbeitest an Wirkstoffen, die Menschen weltweit helfen und bist Teil eines Teams, das moderne Medikamente möglich macht.

Bei Bachem wirst du nicht nur ausgebildet, sondern wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in einer hochmodernen Industrie hinein.

Die Bachem AG wächst weiter und investiert in neue Gebäude sowie moderne Produktionsanlagen zur Herstellung innovativer Produkte. Mit unserer Berufsausbildung verfolgen wir das Ziel, Fach- und Führungskompetenzen nachhaltig aufzubauen, um unser zukünftiges Wachstum erfolgreich zu gestalten.

Wir bieten jährlich neun Lehrstellen als Laborantin / Laborant EFZ Fachrichtung Chemie mit Schwerpunkt Synthese oder Analytik (a) an.

Ausbildungskonzept

Die dreijährige Ausbildung basiert auf dem bewährten trialen Modell mit drei Lernorten:

• Berufsfachschule (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Internes Lehrlabor bei Bachem

• Praxis in verschiedenen Bereichen der Bachem AG

Berufsbild

Laborantinnen und Laboranten EFZ Fachrichtung Chemie sind Expertinnen und Experten im Labor. Sie arbeiten mit unterschiedlichsten Stoffen, die sie untersuchen, aufbereiten oder selbst herstellen.

Im Syntheselabor entwickeln sie neue Moleküle. Aus verschiedenen Ausgangsstoffen entstehen durch gezielte chemische Prozesse neue Verbindungen, Präzision und fundiertes chemisches Verständnis sind dabei entscheidend.

Im Analyselabor prüfen sie Proben auf Identität und Reinheit. Mithilfe moderner Analysegeräte und Methoden stellen sie sicher, dass alle Produkte höchsten Qualitätsanforderungen entsprechen.

Anforderungen

• Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

• Logisches und vernetztes Denken

• Gute Beobachtungsgabe sowie exakte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise

• Zuverlässigkeit und Ausdauer

• Tabellarischer Lebenslauf

Immaginate di lavorare su farmaci che aiutano le persone in tutto il mondo e di essere parte di un team che rende possibili medicine moderne.

A Bachem, non solo sarai addestrato, ma crescerà passo dopo passo in un ruolo responsabile in un'industria all'avanguardia.

Bachem AG continua a crescere e investire in nuovi edifici e moderni impianti produttivi per la produzione di prodotti innovativi. Con la nostra formazione professionale, perseguiamo l'obiettivo di costruire in modo sostenibile competenze specialistiche e di leadership per plasmare con successo la nostra crescita futura.

Ogni anno offriamo nove apprendisti come assistente di laboratorio / assistente di laboratorio EFZ specializzazione in chimica con un focus sulla sintesi o l'analisi (a).

Concetto di formazione

La formazione triennale si basa sul modello di prova collaudato con tre sedi di apprendimento:

• Scuola Professionale (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Laboratorio di insegnamento interno a Bachem

• Pratica in varie aree di Bachem AG

Profilo professionale

I tecnici del laboratorio EFZ Dipartimento di Chimica sono esperti in laboratorio. Lavorano con una vasta gamma di sostanze, che esaminano, elaborano o producono se stessi.

Nel laboratorio di sintesi, sviluppano nuove molecole. Diversi materiali di partenza danno origine a nuovi composti attraverso processi chimici mirati, precisione e comprensione chimica sonora sono cruciali.

Nel laboratorio analitico, testano campioni per identità e purezza. Utilizzando moderni strumenti di analisi e metodi, assicurano che tutti i prodotti soddisfano i più elevati requisiti di qualità.

Requisiti

• Livello scolastico secondario E o P (Baselland) o istruzione equivalente

• Interessi nei contesti scientifici

• pensiero logico e in rete

• Buone capacità di osservazione e metodi di lavoro precisi e attenti

• Affidabilità e resistenza

• Lavoro di squadra e flessibilità

Vantaggi per gli studenti

• Retribuzioni mensili:

1. Anno di formazione: CHF 800. –

2. Anno di formazione: CHF 1’000. –

3. Anno di apprendistato: CHF 1’300. –

• 30 giorni

• Contributo una volta per laptop personale

• Contributo mensile all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici

• e altre prestazioni

Applicazione

Interessante? Allora non vediamo l'ora di vostra applicazione online con:

• Certificati degli ultimi 4-5 semestri

• CV tabulare

• Lettera di motivazione

• Controllare S2 o S3

• Multicheck (se disponibile)

Per i candidati provenienti da Germania o Francia, è richiesta la prova di un permesso di soggiorno valido.

Un apprendistato a Bachem è pratico, versatile e una base ideale per il vostro successo di ingresso nella vita professionale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Imagine working on drugs that help people worldwide and being part of a team that makes modern medicines possible.

At Bachem, you will not only be trained, but will grow step by step into a responsible role in a state-of-the-art industry.

Bachem AG continues to grow and invests in new buildings and modern production facilities for the production of innovative products. With our vocational training, we pursue the goal of sustainably building up specialist and leadership skills in order to successfully shape our future growth.

Every year we offer nine apprenticeships as laboratory assistant / laboratory assistant EFZ specialisation in chemistry with a focus on synthesis or analysis (a).

Training concept

The three-year training is based on the proven trial model with three learning locations:

• Vocational School (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Internal teaching laboratory at Bachem

• Practice in various areas of Bachem AG

Professional profile

Laboratory technicians EFZ Department of Chemistry are experts in the laboratory. They work with a wide variety of substances, which they examine, process or produce themselves.

In the synthesis laboratory, they develop new molecules. Different starting materials give rise to new compounds through targeted chemical processes, precision and sound chemical understanding are crucial.

In the analytical laboratory, they test samples for identity and purity. Using modern analysis equipment and methods, they ensure that all products meet the highest quality requirements.

Requirements

• Secondary school level E or P (Baselland) or equivalent education

• Interest in scientific contexts

• Logical and networked thinking

• Good observation skills as well as exact and careful working methods

• Reliability and endurance

• Teamwork and flexibility

Benefits for learners

• Monthly wages:

1. Year of training: CHF 800. –

2. Year of training: CHF 1’000. –

3. Year of apprenticeship: CHF 1’300. –

• 30 holidays

• One-time contribution for personal laptop

• Monthly contribution to public transport subscription

• and other benefits

Application

Interested? Then we look forward to your online application with:

• Certificates of the last 4-5 semesters

• Tabular CV

• Letter of motivation

• Check S2 or S3

• Multicheck (if available)

For applicants from Germany or France, proof of a valid residence permit is required.

An apprenticeship at Bachem is practical, versatile and an ideal basis for your successful entry into professional life.

Imaginez travailler sur des médicaments qui aident les gens dans le monde entier et faire partie d'une équipe qui rend les médicaments modernes possibles.

Chez Bachem, vous serez non seulement formé, mais vous grandirez pas à pas dans un rôle responsable dans une industrie de pointe.

Bachem AG continue de croître et d'investir dans de nouveaux bâtiments et des installations de production modernes pour la production de produits innovants. Avec notre formation professionnelle, nous poursuivons l'objectif de développer durablement des compétences spécialisées et de leadership afin de façonner avec succès notre croissance future.

Chaque année nous proposons neuf apprentissages comme assistant de laboratoire / assistant de laboratoire EFZ spécialisation en chimie avec un accent sur la synthèse ou l'analyse (a).

Concept de formation

La formation de trois ans est basée sur le modèle éprouvé d'essai avec trois lieux d'apprentissage :

• École professionnelle (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Laboratoire d'enseignement interne à Bachem

• Pratique dans différents domaines de Bachem AG

Profil professionnel

Les techniciens de laboratoire EFZ Département de chimie sont des experts dans le laboratoire. Ils travaillent avec une grande variété de substances, qu'ils examinent, traitent ou produisent eux-mêmes.

Au laboratoire de synthèse, ils développent de nouvelles molécules. Différents matériaux de départ donnent naissance à de nouveaux composés grâce à des procédés chimiques ciblés, la précision et une bonne compréhension chimique sont cruciales.

En laboratoire analytique, ils testent l'identité et la pureté des échantillons. Grâce à l'équipement et aux méthodes d'analyse modernes, tous les produits répondent aux exigences de qualité les plus élevées.

Exigences

• Enseignement secondaire E ou P (Baslland) ou enseignement équivalent

• Intérêt pour les contextes scientifiques

• Pensée logique et en réseau

• Bonnes compétences en observation ainsi que des méthodes de travail précises et prudentes

• Fiabilité et endurance

• Travail d'équipe et flexibilité

Avantages pour les apprenants

• Salaire mensuel

1. Année de formation: CHF 800. –

2. Année de formation: CHF 1.000. –

3. Année d'apprentissage: CHF 1.300. –

• 30 jours fériés

• Contribution unique pour ordinateur portable personnel

• Contribution mensuelle à l'abonnement aux transports publics

• et autres prestations

Demande

Intéressé ? Ensuite, nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature en ligne avec:

• Certificats des 4-5 derniers semestres

• CV tabulaire

• Lettre de motivation

• Vérifiez S2 ou S3

• Vérification multiple (si disponible)

Pour les demandeurs d'Allemagne ou de France, une preuve de permis de séjour valide est exigée.

Un apprentissage chez Bachem est pratique, polyvalent et une base idéale pour votre entrée réussie dans la vie professionnelle.

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium (ETH/FH/TU) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a dedicated Director Project Large CAPEX (a) 100%.

Your tasks:

• Overall responsibility for complex large-scale and investment projects (capex) across all project phases - from the feasibility study to handover to operations.

• Management and control of feasibility, variant and concept studies including technical, economic and regulatory assessment as well as decision preparation for management committees.

• Selection and control of suitable project management models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from the client/owner perspective.

• Ensuring production readiness as well as GMP, safety and legal compliance of systems, buildings and infrastructures.

• Conception, planning and implementation of new buildings and conversions including integration of process, automation and building topics.

• Leading interdisciplinary project teams and managing external partners and service providers.

• Planning, monitoring and implementation of commissioning and qualification of new systems and buildings.

• Budget responsibility including planning, consolidation and monitoring of investment and operating costs.

Your profile:

• Completed technical university degree (ETH/FH/TU) or comparable qualification.

• Several years of experience in managing complex large-scale and investment projects in an industrial environment, ideally GMP-regulated.

• Profound experience with project delivery models such as EPCm, EPC and AE&CM.

• Experience in early project phases (feasibility and concept studies) as well as in governance and decision-making processes.

• Good overall technical understanding of process, automation and building topics.

• Experience in budget and investment management (Capex/Opex).

• Several years of leadership experience as well as strong communication and coordination skills.

• Very good knowledge of German and good English.

Our range:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further training opportunities

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

Controllano e monitorano i processi di produzione semi-automatizzati, lavorano digitalmente con sistemi di misura e controllo e si assumono la responsabilità per gli impianti e manutenzione.

Durante la formazione, gli studenti acquisiscono informazioni in vari settori come l'approvvigionamento energetico, la dispensa e la logistica e conoscere l'intero processo produttivo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Imagine working on drugs that help people worldwide and being part of a team that makes modern medicines possible.

At Bachem, you will not only be trained, but will grow step by step into a responsible role in a state-of-the-art industry.

Bachem AG continues to expand and invests in new buildings and production facilities for the production of innovative products. The goal of our vocational training is the sustainable and long-term development of specialist and leadership skills in the company in order to master future growth.

Every year we offer six apprenticeships as a chemical and pharmatechnologist with a focus on chemical technology (a).

Training concept

The three-year training is based on the proven trial model in three learning locations:

• Vocational School (aprentas in Muttenz and Schweizerhalle)

• ÜK-Zentrum Schweizerhalle (aprentas)

• Practical training at Bachem in various workplaces

Professional profile

Chemical and pharmaceutical technology: EFZs work in modern production facilities and produce important active ingredients such as peptides and oligonucleotides that are used in drugs.

They control and monitor semi-automated production processes, work digitally with measuring and control systems and take responsibility for plants as well as maintenance and maintenance.

During the training, learners gain insights into various areas such as energy supply, dispensation and logistics and get to know the entire production process.

Requirements

• Secondary school level E or P (or equivalent)

• Technical interest and understanding

• Craftsmanship

• Reliability and accuracy

• Endurance and strength

• Teamwork and flexibility

• Certificates of the last 4-5 semesters

• Check S2 or S3

• Multicheck (if available)

For applicants from Germany or France, proof of a valid residence permit is required.

Your main missions

• Know and follow the HSE procedures and directives in force to guarantee the safety of operations and respect for the environment.

• Contribute to the manufacturing of a pharmaceutical product, from ordering raw materials to packaging the finished product.

• Carry out reactor loading operations within industrial facilities.

• Carry out additional production activities: sampling, labeling, cleaning of installations and buildings, maintaining order according to the principles of 5S.

Your profile

• You hold a CFC in chemical and pharmaceutical production technologist, or training deemed equivalent with experience in the chemical or pharmaceutical industry of at least 5 years.

Per la creazione del nostro nuovo gruppo di campionamento, stiamo cercando personalità dedicate che vogliano dare un contributo importante per garantire la qualità del prodotto e la conformità GMP.

Il nostro gruppo di campionamento svolge un ruolo centrale nel monitoraggio di cleanroom, aree di produzione e sistemi idrici. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione con la produzione, il controllo della qualità e altri settori specializzati, si ottiene una panoramica completa dei processi GMP e contribuire attivamente alla qualità dei nostri prodotti.

Stiamo cercando consapevolmente sia specialisti GMP esperti e giovani talenti motivati. Siamo convinti che un team forte beneficia di esperienze diverse e promuove l'apprendimento reciproco.

I loro compiti

• Attuazione delle misure di monitoraggio dell'aria della camera pulita microbiologica (collezione attiva dei germi dell'aria e piastre di sedimentazione)

• Attuazione del monitoraggio delle superfici mediante piastre di bloccaggio

• Effettuare misurazioni delle particelle nelle stanze pulite delle aree di produzione

• Documentazione conforme a GMP di tutti i campionamenti

• Documentazione secondo i requisiti GMP applicabili

• Gestione di attività analitiche selezionate

• Sostegno alla valutazione e alla valutazione della tendenza dei risultati del monitoraggio

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Oligo Production suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n ( Bio-) Chemiker/in als Product Steward (a), 100% für die Sicherstellung reibungsloser Projektabläufe im Bereich Manufacturing.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sie tragen Verantwortung in Kundenprojekten zur (GMP-) Herstellung Oligonukleotid basierter Wirkstoffe und bringen dabei die Anforderungen und Interessen von Kunden und internen Stakeholdern mit den Produktionskapazitäten in Einklang

• Dabei begleiten Sie Projekte im CMC-Management von ersten Aufträgen bis in die potenziell kommerzielle Herstellung und erkennen und managen notwendige Prozessanpassungen

• Durch ihre Koordination und ihr aktives Mitwirken in den Schnittstellen zu u.a. R&D, Supply Chain, technischen Autoren, QC und QA stellen Sie eine reibungslose Produktion gemäss Timelines sicher

• Sie übernehmen die Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden, geben Updates zu laufenden Prozessen und bearbeiten Anfragen rund um die Produktion

• Sie verfasse Abschlussberichte zu Herstellkampagnen und bereiten Kampagnen-Daten übersichtlich auf

• Des Weiteren bearbeiten Sie Dokumente wie technische Berichte, Risikoanalysen, Spezifikationen, SOP`s, Abweichungen oder CAPAs in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen

Die Bachem AG expandiert weiter und investiert in neue Gebäude und Produktionsanlagen zur Herstellung innovativer Produkte. Das Ziel unserer Berufsausbildung ist der nachhaltige und langfristige Aufbau der Fach- und Führungskompetenz im Unternehmen, um das zukünftige Wachstum zu meistern. Jedes Jahr bieten wir eine Lehrstelle zur Logistiker/in EFZ, Fachrichtung Lager (a) an.

Die 3-jährige Ausbildung in der Bachem basiert auf dem Modell der trialen Ausbildung, in welchem an drei Lernorten Theorie, Grundausbildung und Praxis vermittelt werden.

• Den Grossteil der Lehre verbringst du in den zwei Hauptlager für technische und chemische Materialien. Ausserdem besuchst du die Bereiche Tanklager, Entsorgung, Belieferung und Versand. Um den ganzen Prozess der Logistik kenne zu lernen und zu verstehen, gibt es noch 3 kleinere Stagen in den Bereichen Planung, Einkauf und Distribution.

• Während einem Tag pro Woche besuchst du die Gewerbeschule in Liestal. In der Berufskunde werden alle theoretischen Grundlagen gelegt, welche in den Arbeitsabläufen in der Praxis zur Anwendung kommen.

• Neben dieser praktischen und theoretischen Ausbildung absolvieren die Auszubildenden die überbetrieblichen Kurse der SVBL   ( Schweizerische Vereinigung für die Berufsbildung in der Logistik)  und erlangen unter anderem den Staplerfahrausweis.

Berufsbeschreibung:

Das Lager ist die Schaltzentrale unserer Firma. Hier koordinieren Logistiker alle Materialflüsse der unterschiedlichsten Abteilungen im Unternehmen. Angelieferte Waren werden abgeladen, kontrolliert und mittels EDV im System verbucht. Logistiker kommissionieren Waren aufgrund von Kundenbestellungen und stellen den Transport der Güter an ihren Bestimmungsort sicher. Waren werden fachgerecht verpackt, und mit Hilfe moderner Stapler und Flurförderzeuge, nach Vorschriften verladen und gesichert. Sie führen die Kontrolle der Lagerbestände durch und setzten die Anforderungen an einen reibungslosen Güterfluss optimal um. Ein weiteres Aufgabengebiet ist die fachgerechte Entsorgung von Reststoffen und Abfällen, unter Einhaltung aller umweltrechtlichen und gesetzlichen Vorschriften.

Die Logistiker stellen im Team den Warenfluss unter Verwendung moderner Hilfsmittel sicher. Genauso wie sie die Materialflüsse koordinieren sind sie auch die Ansprechpartner für die anderen an den Warenflüssen beteiligten Abteilungen.

Anforderungen:

• Niveau A oder E der Sekundarschule Baselland (oder Gleichwertiges)

• Gute Leistungen in den Kernfächer Deutsch und Mathematik

• Teamfähigkeit und offen Neues zu Lernen

• Freude und Interesse an Zahlen und Sprachen

• Flair und Interesse für die tägliche Arbeit am PC

• Körperliche Aktivitäten sehen Sie als willkommenen Teil Ihres Arbeitsalltags

3. Lehrjahr: CHF 1,300.00 (jeweils x 12)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bachem AG continua ad espandersi e investire in nuovi edifici e impianti produttivi per la produzione di prodotti innovativi. L'obiettivo della nostra formazione professionale è lo sviluppo sostenibile e a lungo termine delle competenze specialistiche e di leadership nell'azienda al fine di padroneggiare la crescita futura. Ogni anno offriamo un apprendistato allo specialista della logistica, magazzino di specializzazione (a).

La formazione di 3 anni a Bachem si basa sul modello di formazione di prova, in cui la teoria, la formazione di base e la pratica sono insegnate in tre luoghi di apprendimento.

• La maggior parte dell'insegnamento è spesa nei due campi principali per materiali tecnici e chimici. Inoltre, si visitano le aree di stoccaggio serbatoio, smaltimento, consegna e spedizione. Per conoscere e comprendere l'intero processo di logistica, ci sono ancora 3 fasi più piccole nei settori della pianificazione, dell'acquisto e della distribuzione.

• Durante un giorno alla settimana si visita la scuola di affari a Liestal. Negli studi professionali vengono poste tutte le basi teoriche, che vengono utilizzate nei processi di lavoro in pratica.

• Oltre a questa formazione pratica e teorica, i tirocinanti completano i corsi intercompany della SVBL (Associazione svizzera per la formazione professionale nella logistica) e ottengono, tra l'altro, la patente di guida per camion.

Descrizione professionale:

Il magazzino è il centro di controllo della nostra azienda. Qui, gli esperti di logistica coordinano tutti i flussi materiali da una vasta gamma di dipartimenti in azienda. Le merci consegnate sono scaricate, controllate e registrate nel sistema dal computer. Gli operatori logistici scelgono merci in base agli ordini del cliente e assicurano il trasporto di merci alla loro destinazione. Le merci sono imballate professionalmente, e con l'aiuto di moderni carrelli elevatori e camion industriali, caricati e protetti secondo le normative. Essi effettuano il controllo delle scorte e implementano in modo ottimale i requisiti per un flusso regolare di merci. Un altro settore di responsabilità è lo smaltimento professionale di materiali e rifiuti residui, nel rispetto di tutte le normative ambientali e legali.

Il team logistico garantisce il flusso di merci utilizzando strumenti moderni. Come coordinano i flussi materiali, sono anche i punti di contatto per gli altri dipartimenti coinvolti nei flussi di merci.

Requisiti

• Livello A o E della scuola secondaria Baselland (o equivalente)

• Buona prestazione nei principali soggetti tedesco e matematico

• Lavoro di squadra e apprendimento aperto

• Gioia e interesse nei numeri e nelle lingue

• Flair e interesse per il lavoro quotidiano sul PC

• Attività fisiche vi vedono come una parte di benvenuto della vostra giornata di lavoro

Bachem Vantaggi per gli studenti:

• Il tuo stipendio mensile: 1° anno di apprendistato: CHF 800.00 / 2. Anno di formazione: CHF 1.000.00 /
3. Maestro
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bachem AG continues to expand and invests in new buildings and production facilities for the production of innovative products. The goal of our vocational training is the sustainable and long-term development of specialist and leadership skills in the company in order to master future growth. Every year we offer an apprenticeship to the logistics specialist, specialization warehouse (a).

The 3-year training in Bachem is based on the model of trial training, in which theory, basic training and practice are taught at three learning locations.

• Most of the teaching is spent in the two main camps for technical and chemical materials. In addition, you visit the areas of tank storage, disposal, delivery and shipping. In order to get to know and understand the whole process of logistics, there are still 3 smaller stages in the areas of planning, purchasing and distribution.

• During one day a week you visit the business school in Liestal. In vocational studies, all theoretical foundations are laid, which are used in the work processes in practice.

• In addition to this practical and theoretical training, the trainees complete the intercompany courses of the SVBL (Swiss Association for Vocational Training in Logistics) and obtain, among other things, the truck driving licence.

Professional description:

The warehouse is the control center of our company. Here, logistics experts coordinate all material flows from a wide range of departments in the company. Delivered goods are unloaded, checked and recorded in the system by computer. Logistics operators pick goods based on customer orders and ensure the transport of goods to their destination. Goods are packed professionally, and with the help of modern forklifts and industrial trucks, loaded and secured according to regulations. They carry out the control of the stockpiles and optimally implement the requirements for a smooth flow of goods. Another area of responsibility is the professional disposal of residual materials and waste, in compliance with all environmental and legal regulations.

The logistics team ensures the flow of goods using modern tools. Just as they coordinate the material flows, they are also the contact points for the other departments involved in the goods flows.

Requirements

• Level A or E of the secondary school Baselland (or equivalent)

• Good performance in the core subjects German and Mathematics

• Teamwork and open learning

• Joy and interest in numbers and languages

• Flair and interest in daily work on the PC

• Physical activities see you as a welcome part of your workday

Bachem Benefits for learners:

• Your monthly salary: 1st year of apprenticeship: CHF 800.00 / 2. Year of training: CHF 1,000.00 /
3. Teacher

La formation de trois ans à Bachem est basée sur le modèle de la formation d'essai, dans lequel la théorie, la formation de base et la pratique sont enseignées dans trois lieux d'apprentissage.

• La plupart de l'enseignement est passé dans les deux principaux camps pour les matériaux techniques et chimiques. De plus, vous visitez les zones de stockage, d'élimination, de livraison et d'expédition des réservoirs. Afin de connaître et de comprendre l'ensemble du processus de logistique, il y a encore trois étapes plus petites dans les domaines de la planification, de l'achat et de la distribution.

• Pendant une journée par semaine, vous visitez l'école de commerce de Liestal. Dans les études professionnelles, toutes les bases théoriques sont posées, qui sont utilisées dans les processus de travail en pratique.

• En plus de cette formation pratique et théorique, les stagiaires complètent les cours interentreprises de la SVBL (Association suisse pour la formation professionnelle en logistique) et obtiennent, entre autres, le permis de conduire par camion.

L'entrepôt est le centre de contrôle de notre société. Ici, les experts en logistique coordonnent tous les flux de matériel d'un large éventail de départements dans l'entreprise. Les marchandises livrées sont déchargées, vérifiées et enregistrées dans le système par ordinateur. Les opérateurs de logistique choisissent des marchandises sur la base des commandes des clients et assurent le transport des marchandises vers leur destination. Ils exercent le contrôle des stocks et appliquent de manière optimale les prescriptions relatives à la fluidité des flux de marchandises. Un autre domaine de responsabilité est l'élimination professionnelle des matières résiduelles et des déchets, conformément à toutes les réglementations environnementales et juridiques.

• Niveau A ou E de l'école secondaire Baselland (ou équivalent)

• Bonne performance dans les matières principales allemand et mathématiques

• Travail d'équipe et apprentissage ouvert

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Für unsere Abteilung QC Late Phase suchen wir aktuell einen engagierten Lab Technician QC mit Fokus HPLC (w/m/d) für eigenständige und präzise analytische Arbeiten in einem spezialisierten Team. Aktuell haben wir eine unbefristete Vakanz, die spannende Einblicke in die späte Phase der Qualitätskontrolle bietet.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Analytische Tätigkeiten: Selbstständige Durchführung von HPLC‑/U(H)PLC‑Analysen im Rahmen von Freigabe-, Stabilitäts- und Entwicklungsprojekten.  Fachgerechte Vorbereitung, Bedienung und Wartung der Geräte, ggf. inkl. Troubleshooting, um zuverlässige Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Dokumentation & Auswertung: Sorgfältige Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte sowie Auswertung der Rohdaten unter Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards (GMP).

• Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Sicherstellung, dass alle Laboraktivitäten den Qualitätsvorgaben und Sicherheitsrichtlinien entsprechen. Bei Qualitätsereignissen (OOX-Fälle) Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung und Dokumentation.

• Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit QA, Produktion und weiteren internen Bereichen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Qualitätssicherung im Labor. Gute Kommunikation und präzise Arbeitsweise zur Unterstützung effizienter und reibungsloser Arbeit im Team.

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Chemielaborant/in, vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt Analytik

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in HPLC/U(H)PLC und Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Durchführung analytischer Methoden

• Berufserfahrung in der chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Industrie idealerweise im GMP-Umfeld

• Kenntnisse im Bereich Peptide / Oligonukleotide wünschenswert

• Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und hohe Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation

• Sicherer Umgang mit computergestützten Systemen; Erfahrung mit LIMS und Chromeleon von Vorteil

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides for the pharmaceutical industry. To strengthen our HSE organization in Vionnaz (Valais, Switzerland), we are looking for an HSE Specialist 100% (all). In this role, you will support site investment projects by ensuring that Health, Safety and Environment requirements are integrated throughout the project lifecycle, from design to commissioning, while promoting safe, compliant, and sustainable operations.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as the HSE representative for site CAPEX projects and technology transfers, ensuring HSE requirements are integrated from the earliest design stages through commissioning.

• Promote Safety by Design principles and risk reduction at source throughout project execution.

• Organize and participate in risk assessments, including HAZOP, PHA, ATEX, fire, ergonomic, and environmental assessments.

• Support PSSR and Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensure implementation of preventive and protective measures.

• Ensure compliance with legal requirements, company standards, and industry best practices, and verify their integration into project documentation and specifications.

• Define and monitor contractor HSE requirements and oversee high-risk activities during construction, installation, and commissioning phases.

• Contribute to inspections, audits, investigations, and the sharing of lessons learned following incidents or near misses.

• Deliver HSE awareness and training activities while driving continuous improvement initiatives across project teams.

Your Profile

• Higher education qualification in HSE, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field; additional training in project management or process safety is an advantage.

• At least five years of experience in an HSE role within a regulated industrial environment such as the chemical, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry.

• Experience supporting investment, expansion, or facility modification projects.

• Proven experience conducting or facilitating industrial risk assessments and working with contractors on industrial sites.

• Strong knowledge of process safety, risk management principles, and industrial safety regulations.

• Familiarity with ATEX, fire protection, environmental protection, industrial hygiene, SIS principles, and OPAM requirements is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization.

• Fluent French and professional proficiency in English; German and experience with HSE management systems are advantageous.

Our offer

• A modern and dynamic working environment within a fast-growing international company.

• Challenging projects of high scientific and technical value.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuing professional development.

• A corporate culture based on collaboration, innovation and excellence.

• Attractive working conditions and competitive employee benefits.

Interested

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

• Offrire attività di sensibilizzazione e formazione HSE mentre guida iniziative di miglioramento continuo tra i team di progetto.

Il tuo profilo

• Forte capacità analitiche, organizzative, di comunicazione e di influenza, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un'organizzazione di matrice.

• Facoltà francese e professionale fluido in inglese; tedesco e l'esperienza con sistemi di gestione HSE sono attraenti.

Your Responsibilities

• Experience supporting investment, expansion, or facility modification projects.

• Proven experience conducting or facilitating industrial risk assessments and working with contractors on industrial sites.

• Strong knowledge of process safety, risk management principles, and industrial safety regulations.
