descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our Supply Chain Europe team, we are looking for a dedicated Category Manager Capex (a) 100%, for the “Construction Services” area within the Indirect Procurement Europe department.

Their tasks

• Perceiving procurement responsibility as a specialist for the preparation of planner, work and supply contracts for new and existing construction projects in English and German

• Create and implement procurement strategies taking into account the specific requirements within the construction projects, regulatory requirements and SIA standards

• Preparation, implementation and / or support of tenders incl. Conducting procurement discussions up to awarding / commissioning

• Execution and monitoring of the entire procurement process up to invoice control, as well as possible supplement management

• Ongoing monitoring of the operational and strategic KPIs of your own area of responsibility

• Ensuring proactive appointment monitoring and initiating measures to ensure controlled appointment changes / corrections

• Sourcing and evaluation of suitable procurement sources incl. Building and maintaining long-term supplier relationships

• Close cooperation with internal stakeholders from the fields of engineering, production, finance and controlling

• Monitoring, analysis and evaluation of market developments, supplier landscapes and industry-specific trends

• Further development of processes, contract templates and systems within the existing system landscape

• Troubleshooting for qualitative or appointment-related problems

• Collaboration in projects as Subject Matter Expert for Procurement

• Mutual representation with the existing Capex Category Managers

Your profile:

• Completed basic training in the technical field with commercial further education (business economist HF, technical merchant sed.) FA, Purchasing Expert Federal FA) or degree in the field of industrial engineering, mechanical engineering or comparable

• > 5 years of professional experience in procurement in the chemical and pharmaceutical industry, at least 2 years of experience in procurement of construction services

• Solid understanding of contract mechanisms in the procurement of technical components and services

• Integrative, winning personality with healthy assertiveness, who thinks entrepreneurially and acts self-initiatively (hands-on) and responsibly

• Negotiable in German and English (written/verbal)

• Flexible, open and curious, with high willingness to perform and pleasure in finding solutions and implementing them

• Secure SAP and MS Office skills applied in the professional environment

• Analytical skills and strategic thinking

• Strong negotiating skills and communication skills

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Flexible working time arrangements with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

• Company-internal KITA on the Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to advantage platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our inspiring working environment at our location in Bubendorf!

• Flexibilität, Kommunikation und Lernbereitschaft gehören zu Ihren Stärken.

• Vorliebe zur Arbeit und Dokumentation nach GMP-Vorgaben sowie Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld von Vorteil.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our drug pilot department, we are looking for a motivated laboratory assistant (a) 100% .

In our production plant, you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production facilities from production to cleaning. Through practical training, you will gain the necessary security to work independently and independently on our production facilities and become part of our team. If it is also important for you to work with us on the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes and appreciate the opportunity to help shape your working conditions, then you are at the right place.

Their tasks:

• They control and monitor our manufacturing processes at the interface to R&D.

• They document GMP and control the batch documentation.

• They help to qualify the production equipment.

• They prepare in-process controls and sample trains and partly carry them out themselves.

• Together with the responsible group leaders, they make decisions for the further course of production on the basis of in-process controls, for example.

• They carry out cleaning and maintenance as well as simple repair work on the production facilities.

• They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. For this purpose, you provide equipment, solvents and starting materials in the respective production rooms and control the apparatus and plants.

• You are actively and independently involved in the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes.

Your profile:

• Chemical laboratory, chemical or equivalent training or chemical and pharmatechnologist.

• Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths.

• Preference to work and documentation according to GMP specifications as well as experience in the GMP environment is advantageous.

• They are characterized by a high degree of reliability, independence and teamwork.

• They are interested in technical connections and automated processes.

• A structured and clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

• Knowledge in organic synthesis and chromatographic purification, as well as common analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC are advantageous

• Experience with activities in the clean room is advantageous, but not a requirement

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

• Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to the advantage platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our drug production department, we are looking for a motivated chemical and pharmaceutical technologist/chemical (m/f/d).

In our production plant, you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production facilities from production to cleaning. Through practical training, you will gain the necessary security to work independently and independently on our production facilities and become part of our team. If it is also important for you to work with us on the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes and appreciate the opportunity to help shape your working conditions, then you are at the right place.

Their tasks:

• They control, monitor and observe our production processes and document GMP-compliant.

• They control the batch documentation.

• They help to qualify the production equipment.

• They prepare in-process controls and sample trains and carry them out themselves.

• Together with the responsible group leaders, they make decisions for the further course of production on the basis of in-process controls, for example.

• They carry out cleaning and maintenance as well as simple repair work on the production facilities.

• They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. For this purpose, you provide equipment, solvents and starting materials in the respective production rooms and control the apparatus and plants.

• You are actively and independently involved in the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes.

Your profile:

• Completed training as a chemical, chemical laboratory or equivalent; or Chemical and pharmaceutical technologists

• Readiness for shift work (early and late shift) No 6/4 or night shift model

• Preference to work and documentation according to GMP specifications as well as experience in the GMP environment is advantageous

• Experience with activities in the clean room is desired

• Strong reliability and independence

• A structured and clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times

• Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths

• They are characterized by a high degree of reliability, independence and teamwork ability

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

• Knowledge in organic synthesis and chromatographic purification, as well as common analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC are advantageous.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working time arrangements and option to receive additional holidays with reduced workload

• Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to the advantage platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our inspiring working environment at our location in Bubendorf!

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

As part of the development of our new Sisslerfeld manufacturing site, we are looking for a Lead QC Sisslerfeld Site Develepoment (a) 100%. In this key role, your focus will be to establish and lead the ramp-up of the Quality Control organization, driving the successful setup of laboratories, systems, and processes while ensuring regulatory compliance, operational readiness, and sustainable quality excellence.

Your tasks

• Build, lead, and continuously develop the Quality Control organization for the Sisslerfeld Site, including the establishment of Microbiology (MIBI) and In-Process Control (IPC) laboratories.

• Ensure implementation of regulatory and compliance requirements and support alignment with internal and external stakeholders throughout project execution.

Vos tâches

• Assurer la conformité aux BPF et la mise en oeuvre des règlements pharmaceutiques applicables tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.

• Examiner et approuver la documentation sur la qualification et la validation, y compris les plans directeurs de qualification, l'URS, les évaluations d'impact du système et les évaluations des risques de qualité.

• Assurer la surveillance de la qualité de la mise en service et de la qualification des systèmes informatisés, de la validation de l'équipement informatisé et des systèmes de TI, y compris DQ, IQ, OQ et PQ.

• Soutenir la conception, l'état de préparation aux qualifications et la conformité des systèmes informatisés tels que PCS7/MES, le système de surveillance et le SGLI, etc.

• Effectuer des examens de conception et gérer les écarts, les contrôles du changement et les activités de diffusion du système du point de vue de la qualité.

• Appuyer la qualification des fournisseurs et collaborer avec les intervenants internes et externes pour assurer la réussite de l'exécution du projet et de l'exécution des étapes.

• Assurer la conformité continue aux BPF en surveillant la qualité des systèmes informatisés, de la documentation sur la qualité, des écarts, des contrôles du changement et des activités d'examen périodique durant la phase opérationnelle.

• Appuyer les vérifications et les inspections réglementaires tout en favorisant l'efficacité du SGQ et l'amélioration continue en collaboration avec les intervenants interfonctionnels.

Votre profil

• Forte connaissance de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) et de la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV), y compris un minimum de trois ans d'expérience dans des projets de CAPEX pharmaceutique faisant intervenir des systèmes CSV tels que PCS7/MES, MOS et LIMS.

• Compétence en qualification et validation pour les systèmes de procédés utilisés dans la fabrication d'API.

• Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires relatives à la qualification et à la validation des systèmes informatisés, des instruments de laboratoire, des systèmes de traitement, des systèmes d'eau purifiée, des salles propres, ainsi que des exigences en matière de nettoyage et de validation des procédés (par exemple, ASTM E2500, lignes directrices de l'UE sur les BPF, annexes 1, 11 et 15, lignes directrices PIC/S, exigences de l'ICH, règlements de la FDA, etc.).

• L'expérience des systèmes de validation électronique tels que KNEAT Gx est considérée comme un avantage.

• Un haut niveau d'engagement et un fort sentiment d'appropriation pour le projet et l'organisation.

• Enthousiasme pour construire et établir un nouveau site de fabrication de BPF avec un état d'esprit pionnier.

• Capacités de communication fortes et efficaces.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches et de gérer plusieurs activités simultanément. Il s'agit là d'un élément essentiel pour faciliter l'exploitation des sites, en particulier pendant la phase du projet.

• Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité d'identifier rapidement les problèmes, de penser analytiquement et de développer des solutions pragmatiques pour relever efficacement les défis.

• Flexibilité et adaptabilité, reconnaissant que les priorités et les responsabilités peuvent changer au cours des différentes phases du projet.

• Excellentes compétences en anglais écrit et parlé; les compétences en langue allemande sont un avantage.

• Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes

• 60 % de la couverture des cotisations de la caisse de retraite par Bachem AG, ainsi que l'option pour les prestations de retraite extra-obligatoires avec notre Régime de retraite Plus

Ihre Aufgaben

• Gewährleistung der GMP-Compliance und Umsetzung der geltenden pharmazeutischen Vorschriften während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung der Dokumentation über Qualifizierung, Validierung und Qualitätsrisikomanagement, einschließlich Qualifizierungs-Masterpläne, URS, Systemfolgenabschätzungen und Qualitätsrisikobewertungen.

• Bereitstellung einer Qualitätsüberwachung für C & Q, einschließlich DQ, IQ, OQ und PQ, Reinigungs- und Prozessvalidierungsaktivitäten.

• Unterstützung des Designs, der Qualifizierungsbereitschaft und der Konformität von Fertigungssystemen, einschließlich Puffervorbereitung und -lagerung, Chromatographie, Tiefenfiltration und Gefriertrocknung.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Qualifizierung, Kalibrierung und Wartung von Geräten, Einrichtungen, Laborgeräten, computergestützten Systemen und Analysemethoden.

• Gewährleistung der fortlaufenden GMP-Compliance durch Qualitätsüberwachung der Fertigungsvorgänge, Qualitätsdokumentation, Abweichungen, Änderungskontrollen und regelmäßige Überprüfungsaktivitäten während der Betriebsphase.

• Unterstützen Sie Audits und regulatorische Inspektionen, während Sie die QMS-Effektivität, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördern.

• Universitätsabschluss oder Abschluss einer Fachhochschule in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) und Computer System Validation (CSV), einschließlich mindestens drei Jahren Erfahrung in pharmazeutischen CAPEX-Projekten im Zusammenhang mit der nachgelagerten Verarbeitung, einschließlich Medienaufbereitung, Chromatographie, Ultrafiltration und Gefriertrocknung.

Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld, dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des possibilités uniques de façonner la future organisation.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre nouveau site de fabrication Sisslerfeld, nous recherchons un gestionnaire QE en aval (a) 100%. Dans ce rôle clé, vous fournirez une surveillance de la qualité en s'associant à des équipes interfonctionnelles pour fournir des systèmes de fabrication conformes, robustes et prêts à l'inspection qui soutiennent l'excellence opérationnelle et la conformité réglementaire depuis le démarrage jusqu'à la fabrication commerciale.

Vos tâches

• Assurer la conformité aux BPF et la mise en oeuvre des règlements pharmaceutiques applicables tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.

• Examiner et approuver la documentation sur la qualification, la validation et la gestion des risques de qualité, y compris les plans directeurs de qualification, l'URS, les évaluations d'impact du système et les évaluations des risques de qualité.

• Assurer la surveillance de l'ingénierie de la qualité pour les C&Q, y compris les activités de DQ, IQ, OQ et PQ, de nettoyage et de validation des processus.

• Soutenir la conception, la préparation à la qualification et la conformité des systèmes de fabrication, y compris la préparation et le stockage des tampons, la chromatographie, la filtration en profondeur et le séchage au gel.

• Effectuer des examens de conception et gérer les écarts, les contrôles du changement et les activités de diffusion des systèmes du point de vue de la qualité et de la conformité.

• Superviser les activités de qualification, d'étalonnage et d'entretien du matériel, des installations, des instruments de laboratoire, des systèmes informatisés et des méthodes d'analyse.

• Assurer la conformité continue aux BPF par la surveillance de la qualité des opérations de fabrication, la documentation sur la qualité, les écarts, les contrôles du changement et les activités d'examen périodique durant la phase opérationnelle.

• Soutenir les vérifications et les inspections réglementaires tout en favorisant l'efficacité du SGQ, l'amélioration continue et la collaboration interfonctionnelle.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire d'une université des sciences appliquées en génie, en chimie, en pharmacie ou dans une discipline connexe.

• Forte connaissance de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) et de la validation du système informatique (CSV), y compris un minimum de trois ans d'expérience dans des projets de CAPEX pharmaceutique liés au traitement en aval, y compris la préparation des médias, la chromatographie, l'ultrafiltration et le séchage au gel.

• Compétence en qualification et validation pour les systèmes de procédés utilisés dans la fabrication d'API.

• Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires relatives à la qualification et à la validation des systèmes informatisés, des instruments de laboratoire, des systèmes de traitement, des systèmes d'eau purifiée, des salles propres, ainsi que des exigences en matière de nettoyage et de validation des procédés (par exemple ASTM E2500, lignes directrices de l'UE sur les BPF, annexes 1, 11 et 15, lignes directrices PIC/S, exigences de l'ICH, règlements de la FDA).

• L'expérience des systèmes de validation électronique tels que KNEAT Gx est considérée comme un avantage.

• Niveau élevé d'engagement et fort sentiment d'appropriation du projet et de l'organisation.

• Enthousiasme pour construire et établir un nouveau site de fabrication de BPF avec un état d'esprit pionnier.

• Capacités de communication fortes et efficaces.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, avec la capacité de hiérarchiser les tâches et de gérer simultanément plusieurs activités pour soutenir les opérations en douceur, particulièrement pendant la phase du projet.

• De solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité d'identifier rapidement les problèmes, de réfléchir analytiquement et de développer des solutions pragmatiques pour surmonter efficacement les défis.

• Flexibilité et adaptabilité, reconnaissant que les priorités et les responsabilités peuvent changer au cours des différentes phases du projet.

• Excellentes compétences en anglais écrit et parlé; les compétences en langue allemande sont un avantage.

• Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes

• Des aliments frais, sains et variés dans notre restaurant du personnel

• Un large éventail d'activités sportives gratuites sur le campus de Bachem

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld, dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des possibilités uniques de façonner la future organisation.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre nouveau site de fabrication Sisslerfeld, nous recherchons un gestionnaire QE Facility & Utility Systems. Dans ce rôle clé, vous assurerez la conformité GxP de la conception, de la mise en service et de la qualification des systèmes CVC, Cleanrooms, Clean Utilities, Media and Process Gas tout au long du cycle de vie de ces systèmes pendant la phase de projet et opérationnelle.

Vos tâches

• Assurer la conformité aux BPF et la mise en oeuvre des exigences réglementaires pendant toutes les phases du projet, depuis la conception jusqu'à la phase opérationnelle.

• Assurer la surveillance technique de la qualité des installations, des services publics, des systèmes de CVC, des salles propres, des services publics propres, des médias et des gaz de procédé ainsi que des systèmes informatisés.

• Examiner et approuver la documentation sur la qualification, la validation et la gestion des risques de qualité.

• Soutenir la mise en service et la qualification (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ), la validation des processus et les activités de validation du nettoyage.

• Assurer l'état de préparation et la conformité des installations et des systèmes d'utilité publique essentiels, y compris les systèmes informatisés.

• Gérer les écarts liés à la qualité, les contrôles du changement et les activités d'amélioration du SGQ.

• Appuyer les inspections réglementaires et les vérifications des clients pendant la phase opérationnelle, en assurant une préparation continue à l'inspection.

• Favoriser la conformité, le rendement en matière de qualité et l'amélioration continue en collaboration avec les intervenants interfonctionnels.

Votre profil

• Diplôme universitaire ou de l'Université des sciences appliquées en génie, chimie, pharmacie ou une discipline scientifique connexe.

• Forte connaissance de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) et de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV), y compris un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience dans les projets de CAPEX pharmaceutique impliquant CVC, salles propres, services publics propres, médias et gaz de procédé.

• Compétence en qualification et validation pour les systèmes de procédés utilisés dans la fabrication d'API.

• Compréhension approfondie des exigences réglementaires liées à la qualification et à la validation des systèmes informatisés, des systèmes de procédés, des systèmes d'eau purifiés Cleanrooms, y compris ASTM E2500, des lignes directrices de l'UE sur les BPF, des annexes 1, 11 et 15, des lignes directrices PIC/S, des exigences de l'ICH, des règlements de la FDA et des normes connexes.

• La connaissance de systèmes de validation électronique tels que KNEAT Gx est considérée comme un avantage.

• Niveau élevé d'engagement et fort sentiment d'appropriation du projet et de l'organisation.

• Enthousiasme pour construire et établir un nouveau site de fabrication de BPF avec un état d'esprit pionnier.

• Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, avec la capacité de hiérarchiser les tâches et de gérer simultanément plusieurs activités pour soutenir les opérations en douceur, particulièrement pendant la phase du projet.

• De solides compétences en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'identifier rapidement les problèmes, de penser analytiquement et de développer des solutions pragmatiques pour surmonter efficacement les défis.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (a), 80-100%

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. For this large-scale CAPEX investment project, we are seeking a Data Engineer.

Your tasks:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines on the Databricks platform using PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.

• Build and optimize enterprise data architectures, including medallion frameworks (Bronze, Silver, Gold), ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across all layers.

• Integrate manufacturing and business-critical data sources such as SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS, and process historians into a unified data ecosystem.

• Develop and manage automated data workflows, orchestration processes, and reusable data products to support analytics, reporting, and operational excellence.

• Implement data governance, security, lineage, and compliance standards, ensuring adherence to GMP, GxP, ALCOA+, and data integrity requirements.

• Monitor and enhance data platform performance through workload optimization, cost management, and adoption of engineering best practices, testing frameworks, and CI/CD processes.

• Collaborate closely with data scientists, process engineers, business stakeholders, QA, and validation teams to translate business needs into production-ready data solutions.

• Enable advanced analytics and machine learning initiatives by providing curated datasets, semantic data models, feature engineering capabilities, and self-service analytics foundations

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data pipelines and data platforms.

• Strong expertise in Databricks technologies, including PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and workflow orchestration.

• Proficient in SQL and Python, with a solid understanding of software engineering best practices, testing, and CI/CD methodologies.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and a good understanding of storage, compute, networking, and identity management.

• Proven track record working in regulated environments, with knowledge of GMP, GxP, data integrity, and audit requirements.

• Experience integrating enterprise and manufacturing systems, ideally including SAP, MES, LIMS, and other OT/IT data sources.

• Pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience is highly desirable, as is familiarity with modern lakehouse architectures, streaming technologies, data platform validation, and Databricks certifications.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in un nuovo sito a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della nostra strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. Per questo grande progetto di investimento CAPEX, stiamo cercando un Data Engineer.

I vostri compiti:

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere le pipeline di dati scalabili e in tempo reale sulla piattaforma Databricks utilizzando PySpark, SQL e Delta Lake.

• Costruire e ottimizzare le architetture di dati aziendali, inclusi i quadri di medaglione (Bronze, Silver, Gold), garantendo qualità dei dati, coerenza e affidabilità su tutti i livelli.

• Integrare la produzione e le fonti di dati business-critical come SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS e gli storici di processo in un ecosistema di dati unificato.

• Sviluppare e gestire flussi di lavoro automatizzati di dati, processi di orchestrazione e prodotti di dati riutilizzabili per supportare analisi, reporting e eccellenza operativa.

• Implementare la governance dei dati, la sicurezza, la linea e gli standard di conformità, assicurando l'adesione a GMP, GxP, ALCOA+ e requisiti di integrità dei dati.

• Monitorare e migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma di dati attraverso l'ottimizzazione del carico di lavoro, la gestione dei costi e l'adozione di best practice ingegneristiche, framework di test e processi CI/CD.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con scienziati di dati, ingegneri di processo, stakeholder aziendali, QA e team di validazione per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni di dati pronte alla produzione.

• Abilitare iniziative di analisi e machine learning avanzate fornendo set di dati curati, modelli di dati semantici, funzionalità di ingegneria e fondazioni di analisi self-service

Il tuo profilo:

• Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria dei dati, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo relativo.

• 5+ anni di esperienza hands-on progettazione, costruzione e gestione di data pipeline e piattaforme di dati su scala aziendale.

• Forte esperienza nelle tecnologie Databricks, tra cui PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog e orchestrazione flusso di lavoro.

• Proficiente in SQL e Python, con una solida comprensione delle migliori pratiche di ingegneria del software, test e metodologie CI/CD.

• Esperienza con piattaforme di dati basate su cloud (AWS e/o Azure) e una buona comprensione di storage, calcolo, networking e gestione dell'identità.

• Provato record di traccia lavorando in ambienti regolamentati, con la conoscenza di GMP, GxP, integrità dei dati e requisiti di audit.

• Esperienza di integrazione di sistemi aziendali e produttivi, tra cui SAP, MES, LIMS e altre fonti di dati OT/IT.

• L'esperienza dell'industria farmaceutica o delle scienze della vita è altamente auspicabile, così come la familiarità con le moderne architetture di Lakehouse, le tecnologie di streaming, la convalida della piattaforma di dati e le certificazioni Databricks.

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne

• Ore lavorative flessibili con i giorni di ufficio e l'opzione per ottenere ulteriori giorni di vacanza attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Centro diurno gestito dall'azienda sul campus di Bachem a Bubendorf

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso a piattaforme di benefici con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Una vasta gamma di attività sportive gratuite sul Bachem Campus

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra posizione a Bubendorf!

jobs.title: IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80-100%

titleByLocale.fr: IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Ingénieur (a), 80-100%

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%.

The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership.

The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations.

In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.

Your tasks:

• Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments.

• Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer (a) , 100% to support our global capital projects and play a key role in the standardization and further development of C&Q processes across our international network. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and management of C&Q activities – from concept to handover – and will contribute your expertise to a wide range of projects worldwide.

Your tasks:

• Leadership of C&Q activities within multidisciplinary large capital projects

• Coordination and management of C&Q‑related deviations and changes within defined timelines and in compliance with required quality standards

• Responsibility for budget, schedule, prioritization, resources, and the quality of C&Q execution

• Analysis of options, planning of execution strategies, and development of detailed C&Q schedules

• Preparation of tender documents, support in procurement processes, and cost estimation

• Ensuring a smooth handover to Operations and Quality

• Risk management, including the derivation of proactive measures in case of deviations

• Management and onboarding of the C&Q team, including external partners

• Responsibility for training C&Q teams and ensuring adherence to internal standards

• Clear, structured, and audience‑appropriate communication with all stakeholders

• Close collaboration with global sites to harmonize C&Q standards and digital processes

• Support in supplier evaluation and coaching of local SMEs

• Active promotion of lean and agile methods within engineering and C&Q contexts

• Technical review activities in CAPEX projects

• Participation in or leadership of international teams in GMP engineering, C&Q, and global initiatives

Your profile:

• Completed degree in engineering, natural sciences, or a related field

• At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry

• Proven experience in international CAPEX projects (medium to large scale, complex requirements)

• Extensive C&Q expertise in areas such as:

• Biologics/Drug Substance, Drug Product

• Small Molecules

• Packaging, warehousing, GMP & non‑GMP infrastructure

• Automation systems & new technologies

• Strong knowledge of global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISPE Integrated Commissioning & Qualification, etc.)

• Ideally experience with KNEAT Gx

• Deep understanding of project management, PQS/EM compliance, and interfaces with Quality

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills

• Analytical thinking and financial acumen to derive sustainable, efficient solutions

• Willingness to drive change, creative thinking, and the ability to support organizations through transformation

• Confident working style in global, culturally diverse teams

Our offer:

We offer you an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic and rapidly growing environment. This position provides you with the opportunity to make a lasting contribution to the company and the region.

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment!

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100% , to design and implement SAP solutions for the establishment of our new planned GMP manufacturing site (Bachem Sisslerfeld).

The role combines deep expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply chain processes with a strong focus on modern, data-driven capabilities and digital innovation. This includes enabling integrated, intelligent, and highly automated processes based on advanced digital technologies. The successful candidate will contribute to building scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP solutions to support digital transformation and operational excellence.

Your tasks:

• Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions supporting manufacturing and supply chain processes, ensuring compliant, standardized system build and deployment across the program

• Enable and optimize end-to-end business processes across production, supply chain, and quality in GMP-regulated environments, applying deep pharma/life science domain expertise

• Architect and implement cross-system integration across SAP and adjacent platforms (MES, LIMS, shopfloor automation), securing seamless data flow and process consistency across the landscape

• Drive digital innovation by delivering data-driven, highly automated processes and supporting the adoption of modern SAP technologies such as SAP Build and SAP AI Services

• Establish and maintain full regulatory compliance (GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001), supporting computer system validation (CSV), risk assessments, and audit readiness

• Engage senior stakeholders across manufacturing, quality, supply chain and IT; translate business needs into architectural solutions and provide governance across program and project lifecycles

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's in IT, Engineering, or related field

• A minimum of seven years in SAP solution design & implementation

• Expertise in ISA-95 integration (MES Level 3 / ERP Level 4–5)

• Hands-on SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP experience

• Knowledge of GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001

• MES and OT/automation systems experience a strong plus

• Fluency in German and English required

• Experience in regulated industries is a plus

Our offer

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our new location in Stein!

I vostri compiti:

• Abilitare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali end-to-end attraverso la produzione, la catena di fornitura e la qualità in ambienti regolati da GMP, applicando competenze di dominio della scienza della farm/vita

• Architetto e implementa l'integrazione tra i sistemi su piattaforme SAP e adiacenti (MES, LIMS, automazione del laboratorio), garantendo un flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità e una coerenza di processo in tutto il paesaggio

Il tuo profilo:

• Bachelor o Master in IT, Ingegneria o campo relativo

• Un minimo di sette anni nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni SAP

• Competenza nell'integrazione ISA-95 (livello MES 3 / livello ERP 4–5)

• Esperienza SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP

• Conoscenza di GxP, CFR Parte 11, Allegato 11, ISO 27001

• I sistemi MES e OT/automazione sperimentano un forte plus

• Fluency in tedesco e inglese richiesto

• L'esperienza nelle industrie regolamentate è un plus

La nostra offerta

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore lavorative flessibili con i giorni di ufficio e l'opzione per ottenere ulteriori giorni di vacanza attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso ai vantaggi piattaforma con sconti da parte di partner esterni

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%.

Your Tasks:

• Lead the full lifecycle management of the Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution System (MES), including solution design, configuration, deployment, validation, maintenance, and continuous improvement

• Support the design and implementation of next-generation MES architectures aligned with smart manufacturing, digital plant strategies, and Pharma 4.0 initiatives

• Drive MES activities across the new facility startup lifecycle, from project design and commissioning through qualification, go-live, and commercial manufacturing operations

• Collaborate with manufacturing, automation, IT/OT, quality, engineering, and global digital teams to define and implement scalable PAS-X solutions

• Translate business and manufacturing process requirements into robust MES functional and technical designs

• Ensure high system availability, reliability, and performance for GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, including on-call and operational support where required

• Manage change control, deviation investigations, incident management, and problem resolution in close collaboration with IT, operations, and system vendors

• Support integration of PAS-X with enterprise and shopfloor systems including ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automation and integration platforms

• Contribute to MES platform standardization, template strategies, and deployment methodologies across global manufacturing sites

• Maintain GMP-compliant documentation throughout the system lifecycle, including specifications, risk assessments, validation deliverables, and operational procedures

• Act as MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, qualification activities, and regulatory interactions

• Support commissioning, qualification, and computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) activities in accordance with GAMP5 and data integrity requirements

Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

• 4 – 6 years of strong hands-on experience with Körber PAS-X MES in regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing environments

• Proven experience supporting MES implementation projects for new manufacturing facilities, site expansions, or large-scale digital transformation programs

• Solid understanding of next-generation MES/IT-OT architectures, system integrations, and smart factory concepts

• Experience with PAS-X modules such as electronic batch records (EBR), materials management, weigh & dispense, workflow design, and master batch record modeling is highly desirable

• Administer a 24/7 operational MES System, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.

• Knowledge of system integration technologies, infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity within GMP manufacturing environments

• Experience with computerized system validation (CSV/CSA), data integrity, and regulatory compliance requirements including GAMP5, Annex 11, and 21 CFR Part 11

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, commissioning and qualification activities, and operational readiness for facility startup

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced project and operational environments

• Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable

Our offer

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our new location in Stein!

• Mantenere la documentazione conforme a GMP durante tutto il ciclo di vita del sistema, comprese le specifiche, le valutazioni di rischio, i risultati di validazione e le procedure operative

• Atto come MES Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) durante gli audit, le ispezioni, le attività di qualificazione e le interazioni normative

• 4 – 6 anni di forte esperienza pratica con Körber PAS-X MES in ambienti di produzione farmaceutica o biotecnologia regolamentati

• Esperienza comprovata che supporta progetti di implementazione MES per nuove strutture di produzione, espansioni dei siti o programmi di trasformazione digitale su larga scala

• Solida comprensione di architetture MES/IT-OT di nuova generazione, integrazioni di sistema e concetti di fabbrica intelligenti

• Esperienza con moduli PAS-X come record elettronici di lotti (EBR), gestione dei materiali, pesa & dispensa, progettazione del flusso di lavoro e modellazione record master batch è altamente auspicabile

• Amministrare un sistema operativo MES 24/7, assicurando elevata disponibilità, affidabilità, prestazioni e disponibilità di disaster recovery.

• Conoscenza delle tecnologie di integrazione del sistema, infrastrutture, networking, virtualizzazione e sicurezza informatica all'interno degli ambienti di produzione GMP

• Esperienza con validazione computerizzata del sistema (CSV/CSA), integrità dei dati e requisiti di conformità normativi tra cui GAMP5, Allegato 11 e 21 CFR Parte 11

• Forte comprensione dei processi di produzione farmaceutica, delle attività di messa in servizio e di qualificazione, e la disponibilità operativa per l'avvio delle strutture

• Eccellente gestione, comunicazione e competenze di collaborazione tra le parti interessate

• Forte capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi con la capacità di operare efficacemente in ambienti operativi e di progetto veloci

• Fluente in inglese; le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono altamente auspicabili

La nostra offerta

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore lavorative flessibili con giorni di ufficio domestico e un'opzione per ottenere giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso ai vantaggi piattaforma con sconti da parte di partner esterni

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra nuova location a Stein!

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a Data Platform Owner Databricks (a), 80-100%

• Define platform architecture and standards for Unity Catalog, workspaces, compute, networking, data layers, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD

• Establish scalable data ingestion and integration patterns for systems such as SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS, and ELN

• Ensure GxP compliance, platform qualification, data integrity (ALCOA+), audit readiness, access control, change control, and backup/recovery

• Manage day-to-day platform operations, including monitoring, incident, problem, change, release, security, and access management

• Drive FinOps and vendor management, ensuring cost transparency, optimization, licensing, support, and effective partner collaboration

• Enable self-service data capabilities through guardrails, onboarding, documentation, and a community of practice, while coordinating internal and external platform resources

Your profile:

• 5+ years of experience in data platform engineering or ownership, including 3+ years managing Databricks in production end to end

• Strong hands-on expertise in Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, workspace administration, cluster/job management, and Databricks SQL

• Experience running Databricks on AWS, with solid knowledge of IAM, VPC, S3, and KMS

• Good understanding of GxP requirements and regulated environments, including GAMP 5, ALCOA+, CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and change control

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Databricks Asset Bundles

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts and trade-offs for business, quality, and leadership stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Project Procurement Lead (a) 100% - Sisslerfeld

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Senior Procurement del Progetto (a) al 100% - Sisslerfeld
titleByLocale.fr: Chef principal de projet (a) 100 % - Sisslerfeld

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is planning a future site in Sisslefeld in Northwestern Switzerland. As part of Bachem’ s long-term strategy, the planned site is expected to strengthen the company’s global manufacturing network and to expand future production capacity. Joining the team at this stage offers unique opportunities to help shape a new site organization and contribute to Bachem’s growth journey.

The project offers a unique opportunity to help shape one of the most significant pharm aceutical CAPEX investments in Switzerland. To strengthen our Global Project organization, we are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Project Procurement Lead (a) 100%.

Your responsibilities:

Lead the procurement workstream of Bachem Sisslerfeld and act as the single procurement point of contact. Coordinate all procurement activities across Category Managers, Engineering, PMO and project leadership while ensuring optimal commercial outcomes.

• Act as Procurement Project Lead (PPL) for the Bachem Sisslerfeld Program and serve as the single point of contact for all project procurement activities.

• Define and drive the overall procurement, sourcing and commercial strategy in close alignment with Project Management and Engineering.

• Coordinate and align procurement activities across all CAPEX Category Managers responsible for Construction, Equipment, Installation & Interieur, Automation and Engineering Services.

• Support and partially lead commercial negotiations and award recommendations for major contracts, strategic suppliers and critical project packages.

• Own procurement governance, risk management and ensure reporting across the project procurement portfolio.

• Partner closely with Legal to support contract reviews of complex contracts, orders and amendments,

• Prepare and drive claims and commercial disputes in cooperation with the Category Manager, Legal and PMO.

• Drive contract and change order management, ensuring commercial risks and opportunities are identified and properly managed throughout the project lifecycle.

• Represent Procurement in project leadership meetings, steering committees and executive stakeholder reviews.

• Act as a trusted advisor and interface to Project Leadership on procurement, contractual and commercial matters

• Ensure alignment with Bachem procurement standards, policies and governance requirements.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, Economics or a related discipline; additional qualifications in Procurement, Contract Management, Project Management, Commercial or Legal Management are a strong advantage.

• 10-15+ years of experience in Procurement, Commercial and Contract Management within large CAPEX projects, ideally in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical, industrial manufacturing or construction sector.

• Proven track record in managing complex procurement packages, strategic suppliers and high-value commercial negotiations across major project delivery models (EPCM, EPC, Construction Management).

• Strong expertise in contract lifecycle management, claims management, change orders, dispute resolution and risk allocation.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional and matrix organizations, collaborating effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategic procurement mindset combined with strong commercial acumen, business judgment and decision-making capabilities.

• Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills, including executive-level interactions.

• Collaborative and resilient personality with a high level of ownership, accountability and the ability to drive results in demanding project environments.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines.

• Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with attractive internal career development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, and the option to purchase additional vacation days through a reduced workload arrangement

• Bachem AG covers 60% of pension fund contributions, with the option of enhanced retirement savings through our elective savings plan

• Access to employee benefits platforms offering discounts with external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming a highly motivated professional who is eager to contribute to the successful establishment and operation of our new API manufacturing site in Sisslerfeld.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem sta progettando un futuro sito a Sisslefeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Nell’ambito della strategia a lungo termine di Bachem, il sito previsto è destinato a rafforzare la rete produttiva globale dell’azienda e ad ampliare la capacità produttiva futura. Partecipare al team in questa fase offre opportunità uniche per contribuire a formare una nuova organizzazione del sito e contribuire al viaggio di crescita di Bachem.

Il progetto offre un'opportunità unica per contribuire a formare uno dei più significativi investimenti aceutici di pharm CAPEX in Svizzera. Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione del Progetto Globale, stiamo cercando un Leader di Procurement Senior (a) al 100%.

Le tue responsabilità:

Guidare il flusso di lavoro di approvvigionamento di Bachem Sisslerfeld e agire come unico punto di contatto di approvvigionamento. Coordinare tutte le attività di approvvigionamento attraverso i responsabili di categoria, Ingegneria, PMO e leadership di progetto, garantendo al contempo risultati commerciali ottimali.

• Atto come Project Lead (PPL) per il programma Bachem Sisslerfeld e servire come unico punto di contatto per tutte le attività di approvvigionamento di progetti.

• Definire e guidare la strategia globale di approvvigionamento, approvvigionamento e commerciale in stretto allineamento con Project Management e Engineering.

• Coordinare e allineare le attività di approvvigionamento in tutti i responsabili di CAPEX Categoria per la costruzione, l'attrezzatura, l'installazione e l'interieur, l'automazione e i servizi di ingegneria.

• Supporto e in parte condurre negoziati commerciali e raccomandazioni di aggiudicazione per i principali contratti, fornitori strategici e pacchetti di progetto critici.

• La propria governance degli appalti, la gestione dei rischi e la reportistica in tutto il portafoglio degli appalti di progetto.

• Partner strettamente con Legale per sostenere le recensioni contrattuali di contratti complessi, ordini e modifiche,

• Preparare e guidare reclami e controversie commerciali in collaborazione con il Responsabile Categoria, Legale e PMO.

• Il contratto di guida e la gestione degli ordini di cambiamento, garantendo rischi commerciali e opportunità sono identificati e gestiti correttamente in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Rappresentare Procurement in incontri di leadership di progetto, comitati di sterzo e recensioni di stakeholder executive.

• Atto come consulente e interfaccia di fiducia per la Leadership del progetto in materia di appalti, contrattuali e commerciali

• Assicurare l'allineamento con gli standard di approvvigionamento Bachem, politiche e requisiti di governance.

Il tuo profilo:

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Diritto, Economia o una disciplina correlata; qualifiche aggiuntive in appalti, gestione dei contratti, gestione dei progetti, gestione commerciale o legale sono un forte vantaggio.

• 10-15 anni di esperienza in Procurement, Commercial and Contract Management all'interno di grandi progetti CAPEX, idealmente nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico, chimico, industriale o costruzione.

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione di pacchetti di approvvigionamento complessi, fornitori strategici e trattative commerciali ad alto valore nei principali modelli di fornitura di progetti (EPCM, EPC, Construction Management).

• Forte competenza nella gestione del ciclo di vita contrattuale, gestione dei crediti, ordini di cambiamento, risoluzione delle controversie e allocazione dei rischi.

• Dimostrata capacità di guidare e influenzare le organizzazioni interfunzionali e matrici, collaborando efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni senior.

• Mindset di approvvigionamento strategico combinato con forte acum commerciale, giudizio d'affari e capacità decisionali.

• Ottima negoziazione, gestione delle parti interessate, capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, comprese le interazioni a livello esecutivo.

• Personalità collaborativa e resiliente con un alto livello di proprietà, responsabilità e capacità di guidare i risultati in ambienti di progetto esigenti.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di priorità con la capacità di gestire più priorità concorrenti e scadenze strette.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese, sia scritto che parlato.

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con interessanti opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interna

• Ore lavorative flessibili, la possibilità di lavorare da casa, e la possibilità di acquistare giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso una disposizione ridotta del carico di lavoro

• Bachem AG copre il 60% dei contributi dei fondi pensione, con l'opzione di un maggiore risparmio di pensione attraverso il nostro piano di risparmio elettivo

• Accesso alle piattaforme di benefici dei dipendenti che offrono sconti ai partner esterni

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione e di accogliere un professionista altamente motivato che è desideroso di contribuire alla creazione e al funzionamento di successo del nostro nuovo sito di produzione API a Sisslerfeld.

jobs.description:
Join us in shaping Bachem’s new global Quality organization. As Global Head Quality Systems & Services (a), 100% , you will provide global leadership for quality systems, eQMS, quality risk management, training, document management and global quality services across the Bachem network.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute your expertise to a strategic transformation and help define how this new organization will operate globally across Bachem. We encourage qualified colleagues from all Bachem locations to apply and bring their experience to this important journey.

Your key responsibilities:

• Lead the global Quality Systems & Services department across QMS, Quality Risk Management, Training, eQMS/document management and Global Quality Services & Support.

• Oversee and continuously improve global QMS processes and platforms, ensuring compliant, efficient and harmonized execution across the business.

• Define and maintain the global Quality Risk Management framework to support compliant, science- and risk-based decision-making.

• Develop and oversee global eQMS, document management and GxP training standards, including governance, oversight and continuous improvement.

• Build and develop a high-performing global team through clear accountabilities, strong collaboration, capability building and talent development.

• Provide global quality support to sites and functions, including process guidance, system support, troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.

Your profile:

• University degree in life sciences, pharmacy, chemistry, biotechnology, engineering or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree or PhD preferred.

• Minimum 12–15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech or CDMO industry, with strong exposure to GMP-regulated environments.

• Several years of global or multi-site leadership experience in Quality Systems, Quality Risk Management, Training, Operational Quality Support or related Quality functions.

• Proven track record in driving quality system transformations and improving global QMS, eQMS/document management, deviation, CAPA, change control and training frameworks.

• Strong expertise in Quality Risk Management, RCA methodologies, investigation standards and risk-based decision-making.

• Strong understanding of global GMP requirements, quality system expectations and audit/inspection readiness.

• Strong senior stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across sites, functions and leadership levels.

• Excellent English & German skills are required

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Are you ready to shape global quality systems, training, risk management and quality services at Bachem?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are always looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed Local Head of Technical Operations at our headquarters in Bubendorf (a), 100% .

The Head of Technical Operations (a) 100% is responsible for leading key technical domains within the local Technical Operations organization, ensuring high-quality execution in alignment with global standards and local strategic priorities. This role supports the Global Head of Technical Operations in building and managing a robust technical foundation at the site, with a strong focus on the implementation of new chemical entities (NCEs), innovation, and compliance. This role acts as a senior leader within the site leadership team, managing domain leads and technical experts across multiple functions such as troubleshooting, process optimization, product stewardship, validation, and technical documentation.

Your tasks:

• Lead technical operations across multiple domains, aligning local priorities with global TechOps strategy and business objectives

• Manage and develop teams of technical experts and domain leads, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Oversee troubleshooting, process optimization, validation, process safety, and technical support for manufacturing operations

• Drive product stewardship, technology transfers, new product introductions, lifecycle management, and technical input to CAPEX projects

• Technical Operations responsibility for customer NCE projects, including regular customer interaction and participation in project steering committees

• Support digitalization and automation initiatives, including OT systems, process simulations, and data analytics

• Ensure GMP, regulatory, and technical readiness, including documentation, audits, inspections, and submissions

• Strong on-site presence and support

• Shape strategic direction, make high-impact decisions, and influence senior stakeholders across functions, sites, and matrix organizations

• Contribute to the ramp-up of the TechOps organization at the site, ensuring operational readiness and alignment with future harmonization efforts

Your profile:

• Master’s or PhD degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or CDMO environment, including at least 5 years in senior leadership within Technical Operations, Manufacturing Science, or a comparable function

• Extensive expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, technology transfer, process optimization, validation, process safety, operational excellence, and product lifecycle management

• Proven track record in leading complex technical organizations and cross-functional teams, including experience with matrix leadership and influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority

• Strong experience in transformation, digitalization, automation, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to implement global standards across organizations with different levels of maturity

• Strategic and enterprise-oriented mindset, combined with strong decision-making skills and the ability to balance business priorities, operational needs, quality, compliance, and risk in complex environments

• Excellent leadership and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop talent, build strong leadership teams, align diverse stakeholders, and lead effectively through change and ambiguity

• Fluent in German and English

• Strong proficiency in MS Office and relevant technical systems such as SAP, MES, production planning, and data analytics tools

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

They support the implementation of the Bachem Group’s global liquidity and financing strategy. They ensure access to capital, manage financial risks and support management in strategic decisions regarding financing, capital structure and financial management of the Group. In addition, you will take on selected tasks in the areas of corporate finance and group accounting and support the preparation and analysis of the Group’s consolidated financial reporting. • Support and further development of the global insurance portfolio

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Lead (f/m/d), 100%.

In this role, you are responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and oversight of commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for GMP ‑ regulated pharmaceutical facilities. Furthermore, this role ensures that all systems, equipment, and utilities are delivered in full compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project timelines. Acting as a technical and regulatory leader, the position interfaces closely with Engineering, Quality, Automation, Operations, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Your tasks:

• Lead and manage commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems

• Develop and implement C&Q strategies, C&Q Master Plans, and risk ‑ based qualification approaches

• Author, review, and approve GMP documentation including URS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and reports

• Ensure compliance with GMP regulations and internal quality standards

• Act as the primary C&Q interface to Quality Assurance and support regulatory inspections and audits

• Coordinate cross ‑ functional stakeholders and manage external vendors and CQV consultants

• Monitor progress, manage risks, deviations, and change controls, and provide transparent reporting to project leadership

• Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practices across C&Q activities

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline

• Extensive experience in Commissioning & Qualification / Validation within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of leading C&Q activities on large scale GMP capital projects

• Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (EU/FDA), ISPE guidelines, and risk based qualification methodologies

• Experience with facilities and utilities (e.g. HVAC, media systems); automation and CSV experience is an advantage

• Excellent written and spoken German and English

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!
